phrases.optionalEnglishExplanation: Routes and connections enabling movement between places.
phrases.usageNote: link对象要清楚。

examples.sentenceText: Better transport links and reliable delivery help expand market access for both rural buyers and local producers.
examples.translation: 更好的交通联系和可靠配送有助于扩大农村买家与当地生产者的市场接入。

phrases.optionalEnglishExplanation: Progress that considers the needs of different places or groups.
phrases.usageNote: 不是要求各地人口或经济完全相同。

examples.sentenceText: Public services must develop alongside trade if growth is to support balanced development.
examples.translation: 若增长要支持均衡发展，公共服务就必须随交易同步发展。

phrases.optionalEnglishExplanation: Harm or resource burdens imposed on the natural environment.
phrases.usageNote: 评论需与图中行业或行为相关。

examples.sentenceText: Environmental costs can rise when more parcels mean unnecessary journeys and excessive packaging.
examples.translation: 更多包裹造成不必要运输与过度包装时，环境代价可能上升。

phrases.optionalEnglishExplanation: The amount of useful output obtained from available resources.
phrases.usageNote: 需说清资源和规划内容，不作空洞结尾。

examples.sentenceText: Shared routes and reusable materials can improve resource efficiency without removing useful services.
examples.translation: 共用线路与可重复利用材料能在不减少有用服务的情况下提升资源效率。

phrases.optionalEnglishExplanation: Positive effects that continue rather than disappear quickly.
phrases.usageNote: 用条件句区分规模与最终价值。

examples.sentenceText: Continued progress should therefore concern lasting benefits, not volume alone.
examples.translation: 因此，持续进步应着眼于持久收益，而不只关注业务量。

sentencePatterns.pattern: Thank you for [感谢事项].
sentencePatterns.function: 感谢对方的具体行动
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: for后填名词短语或动名词短语。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 适用于感谢祝贺、邀请与分享，后文再展开收获。

examples.sentenceText: Thank you for your congratulations.
examples.translation: 谢谢你的祝贺。

examples.sentenceText: Thank you for your invitation.
examples.translation: 感谢您的邀请。

examples.sentenceText: Thank you for sharing the video of your family’s trip to China.
examples.translation: 谢谢你分享全家在中国旅行的视频。

bindings.感谢事项: sharing the video of your family’s trip to China

sentencePatterns.pattern: [帮助] meant a great deal: it helped me [认识] and [后续行动].
sentencePatterns.function: 用具体改变说明帮助的价值
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 冒号后解释meant a great deal；helped后并列动词原形。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 感谢不是堆形容词，应说明帮助带来什么变化。

examples.sentenceText: Your advice meant a great deal: it helped me understand my options and decide what to do next.
examples.translation: 你的建议意义重大，让我理解了可选道路，并决定下一步行动。

examples.sentenceText: Such a memorable experience meant a great deal: it helped me understand American culture and appreciate your kindness.
examples.translation: 如此难忘的经历意义重大：它让我理解了美国文化，也让我更珍惜你的好意。

sentencePatterns.pattern: It would be a pleasure to [回应] by [具体帮助].
sentencePatterns.function: 从感谢自然转入回报或邀请
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: It为形式主语；by后两个动名词并列。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 后半部分必须给实际可提供的帮助。

examples.sentenceText: It would be a pleasure to return your kindness by showing you around my city and introducing you to our traditions and local food.
examples.translation: 我很乐意带你游览我的城市，介绍我们的传统和当地食物，以回报你的好意。

bindings.具体帮助: showing you around my city and introducing you to our traditions and local food

sentencePatterns.pattern: [新阶段] calls for [能力要求], so [准备行动] will help.
sentencePatterns.function: 用新阶段要求解释准备建议
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: calls for接名词；so连接原因与建议；getting为主语。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 新阶段、能力与做法必须对应。

examples.sentenceText: University learning calls for greater independence, so getting used to organizing your own time will help.
examples.translation: 大学学习要求更强的独立性，因此习惯自行安排时间会有帮助。

bindings.准备行动: getting used to organizing your own time

sentencePatterns.pattern: It would be wonderful if you could [参与任务].
sentencePatterns.function: 委婉邀请完成具体参与任务
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: if you could降低命令感；任务应有明确范围。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 适合邀请发言、分享经验等，不给过多准备要求。

examples.sentenceText: It would be wonderful if you could share one challenge you encountered and how you dealt with it.
examples.translation: 若你能分享一个遇到的困难及应对办法，那就太好了。

bindings.参与任务: share one challenge you encountered and how you dealt with it

examples.sentenceText: It would be wonderful if you could introduce a favourite dish from your own country.
examples.translation: 如果你们能介绍一道自己国家喜爱的菜肴，那就太好了。

bindings.参与任务: introduce a favourite dish from your own country

sentencePatterns.pattern: Knowing that you have [对方已做安排], I sincerely apologize for [具体影响].
sentencePatterns.function: 承认对方付出后道歉
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: Knowing的逻辑主语为I；for后接动名词。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 对方确已安排才使用，不能无依据假定。

examples.sentenceText: Knowing that you have set aside time for me, I sincerely apologize for disrupting your arrangements.
examples.translation: 想到您已专门为我留出时间，我为打乱您的安排诚恳道歉。

examples.sentenceText: Knowing that you have set aside time for me, I sincerely apologize for disrupting your arrangements by changing our meeting.
examples.translation: 知道您已为我留出时间，我为更改会面、打乱您的安排诚恳致歉。

bindings.具体影响: disrupting your arrangements by changing our meeting

sentencePatterns.pattern: If [替代安排] would suit you better, I will gladly [配合行动].
sentencePatterns.function: 尊重对方偏好并提供调整
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: if从句用would表示委婉偏好；主句给承诺。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 改约应先给具体建议，此句用于保留弹性。

examples.sentenceText: If another date would suit you better, I will gladly adjust my plans.
examples.translation: 若其他日期更合适，我很愿意调整计划。

examples.sentenceText: If the following week would suit you better, I will gladly meet at your convenience.
examples.translation: 如果下一周对您更合适，我很乐意在您方便时会面。

sentencePatterns.pattern: I am writing about [商品或服务][补充说明].
sentencePatterns.function: 交代投诉对象并补充说明
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 补充说明可用分词短语交代购买背景，也可用逗号加which从句说明问题。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不是泛泛抱怨，后文应列事实与补救要求。

examples.sentenceText: I am writing about your online writing course, which has failed to meet the stated standard.
examples.translation: 我就贵方在线写作课程来信，课程未达到所声明的标准。

bindings.补充说明: , which has failed to meet the stated standard

examples.sentenceText: I am writing about an electronic dictionary purchased from your online store three days ago.
examples.translation: 我就三天前从贵网店购买的电子词典来信。

bindings.补充说明: purchased from your online store three days ago

sentencePatterns.pattern: For [任务], I suggest [方法] so that we can [目的].
sentencePatterns.function: 把方法与调查目的连接
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: suggest后接动名词；so that说明目的。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 替换方法后须确认确能回答对应问题。

examples.sentenceText: For our survey on old-house protection, I suggest combining field observations with interviews so that we can understand both the buildings’ condition and residents’ concerns.
examples.translation: 关于我们的老屋保护调查，我建议把实地观察与访谈结合，以同时了解建筑状况和居民关切。

bindings.目的: understand both the buildings’ condition and residents’ concerns

examples.sentenceText: For our investigation, I suggest making field observations and conducting interviews so that we can collect reliable evidence and identify common concerns.
examples.translation: 对于这次调查，我建议开展实地观察与访谈，以便收集可靠依据并找出共同关切。

bindings.方法: making field observations and conducting interviews
bindings.目的: collect reliable evidence and identify common concerns

sentencePatterns.pattern: Which [对象] [主要感受], and why?
sentencePatterns.function: 围绕同一经历追问感受与理由
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: Which疑问句后接and why，避免互不相关的问题清单。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 询问对方的真实经历，不转写自己的旅游报告。

examples.sentenceText: Which place left the strongest impression on you, and why?
examples.translation: 哪个地方给你印象最深，为什么？

bindings.主要感受: left the strongest impression on you

sentencePatterns.pattern: The [A人口] more than doubled, rising from [A起点] to [A终点], while the [B人口] declined from [B起点] to [B终点].
sentencePatterns.function: 同句对照相反趋势及幅度
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: rising补充more than doubled；while对照另一组。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: more than doubled要求终值超过起值两倍；不满足时改用适当变化动词。

examples.sentenceText: The urban population more than doubled, rising from 300 million to 666 million, while the rural population declined from 834 million to 674 million.
examples.translation: 城镇人口由三亿增至六亿六千六百万，达到两倍以上；乡村人口则由八亿三千四百万降至六亿七千四百万。

sentencePatterns.pattern: Particularly striking is [显著变化] from [开始时间] to [结束时间].
sentencePatterns.function: 突出最值得注意的变化
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: Particularly striking是前置表语，后接is及真正主语。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 适合确有突出的幅度或阶段，不应只为倒装而用。

examples.sentenceText: Particularly striking is the doubling of rural volume from 2019 to 2020.
examples.translation: 尤其突出的是农村业务量在2019至2020年翻倍。

examples.sentenceText: Particularly striking is the rapid expansion of the developing market from 2000 to 2008.
examples.translation: 尤其显著的是2000至2008年发展中市场的迅速扩张。

bindings.显著变化: the rapid expansion of the developing market

sentencePatterns.pattern: [主要类别] remained [原地位], although its share fell from [起点] to [终点].
sentencePatterns.function: 兼顾份额变化与仍居主导的地位
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: although引导让步，主句不再重复but。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 下降不等于失去第一，必须看实际排序。

examples.sentenceText: Employment remained the largest category, although its share fell from 68.1% to 60.7%.
examples.translation: 就业仍是最大类别，尽管份额由68.1%降至60.7%。

sentencePatterns.pattern: Together, [类别A] and [类别B] account for [合计份额] [统计对象].
sentencePatterns.function: 合并主要选项概括中心
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: Together将两项作为整体；统计对象须据题意用responses或spending等，并只合并互斥构成。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 多选可重叠时不能把选项比例相加当去重人数。

examples.sentenceText: Together, sightseeing and relaxation account for seven out of every ten responses.
examples.translation: 观景与放松合计占每十份回答中的七份。

examples.sentenceText: Together, transport and meals account for 40% of spending.
examples.translation: 交通与聚餐合计占支出的40%。

sentencePatterns.pattern: [收益A] and [收益B] receive almost identical support, at [A比例] and [B比例].
sentencePatterns.function: 准确表达几乎相同的支持
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: receive的主语是并列两项；at引出数据。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: almost identical用于微小差异，不夸大领先。

examples.sentenceText: Satisfying curiosity and developing observation skills receive almost identical support, at 54.6% and 54.5%.
examples.translation: 满足好奇心与促进观察力得到几乎相同的支持，分别为54.6%与54.5%。

sentencePatterns.pattern: Among [群体], [比例A] are [态度A] and [数量B] are [态度B].
sentencePatterns.function: 描述一组内部的两种态度
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: Among限定组内范围；and并列两个主谓结构。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: none satisfied不等于everyone dissatisfied，可能还有中立或不清楚。

examples.sentenceText: Among employees aged 41 to 50, 64% are dissatisfied and none are satisfied.
examples.translation: 41至50岁员工中，64%不满意，无人表示满意。

sentencePatterns.pattern: The proportion rose from [起点] to [终点], with growth becoming more pronounced in [阶段].
sentencePatterns.function: 变化描述后补充阶段差异
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: with加名词及分词短语，补充增长后期更显著。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 必须有数据支持后期加快，不是所有上升图都用。

examples.sentenceText: The proportion rose from 8.80% to 25.40%, with growth becoming more pronounced in later years.
examples.translation: 比例由8.80%升至25.40%，后期增长更明显。

sentencePatterns.pattern: [因素A] accounts for [份额概括], at [A比例], while [因素B] represent [B比例].
sentencePatterns.function: 概括较小比例并交代其他项
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: while并列比较；at给近似描述的实际数值。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 只用在互斥构成，不能把被选比例当效果增幅。

examples.sentenceText: Price accounts for less than a tenth, at 8.4%, while other factors represent 4.7%.
examples.translation: 价格占不到十分之一，为8.4%，其他因素为4.7%。

sentencePatterns.pattern: It reaches [比例] in [组别], making [主体] [比较评价] by [程度].
sentencePatterns.function: 数据之后立即归纳群体差异
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: making引导结果状语；It回指前文比例。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 需要明确前文对象，年级不可改写成连续年份。

examples.sentenceText: It reaches 88.24% in the final year, making graduating students the most active participants by a considerable margin.
examples.translation: 大四达到88.24%，毕业年级以明显差距成为参与最积极的群体。

sentencePatterns.pattern: The strongest benefits concern [主要收获].
sentencePatterns.function: 从多个数据提炼共同特点
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: concern在此意为涉及；through说明学习方式。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 归纳应能覆盖最高几项，不是照抄一个标签。

examples.sentenceText: The strongest benefits concern learning through direct participation.
examples.translation: 最突出的收益是通过亲身参与学习。

examples.sentenceText: The strongest benefits concern intellectual exploration.
examples.translation: 最突出的收益涉及智力探索。

sentencePatterns.pattern: As [阶段变化], [能力] becomes more valuable: [实际需求].
sentencePatterns.function: 处境变化带来需求并影响选择
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: As引出阶段；冒号后解释能力为何更有价值。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不是年龄或年级本身导致结果，应写具体需求。

examples.sentenceText: As graduation approaches, practical experience becomes more valuable: students need to test career interests, develop transferable skills and demonstrate their abilities to employers.
examples.translation: 随着毕业临近，实践经验更有价值：学生需要探索职业兴趣、发展可迁移技能，并向雇主展示能力。

bindings.实际需求: students need to test career interests, develop transferable skills and demonstrate their abilities to employers

sentencePatterns.pattern: [活动] offers [直接作用], while [情境] provide [体验].
sentencePatterns.function: 解释活动如何满足两种相关需要
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: while连接两种机制，而非只罗列活动好处。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 替换后注意单复数与动词一致。

examples.sentenceText: Travel offers a temporary escape from familiar pressures, while natural surroundings provide pleasure that everyday routines may lack.
examples.translation: 旅游让学生暂离熟悉压力，自然环境也提供日常作息可能缺少的乐趣。

bindings.直接作用: a temporary escape from familiar pressures
bindings.体验: pleasure that everyday routines may lack

examples.sentenceText: Television offers information and entertainment with little physical effort, while walks provide gentle exercise and opportunities to meet neighbours.
examples.translation: 看电视无需太多体力便能获得信息和娱乐，散步则提供温和运动及与邻居见面的机会。

bindings.直接作用: information and entertainment with little physical effort
bindings.体验: gentle exercise and opportunities to meet neighbours

sentencePatterns.pattern: One possible explanation is that [条件] made [目标] easier to [行动].
sentencePatterns.function: 用门槛降低解释参与变化
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: One possible explanation is that后接完整从句；made接宾语和补足语。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 这是可能解释，需与图中活动相关。

examples.sentenceText: One possible explanation is that more accessible sessions made regular physical activity easier to fit into daily routines.
examples.translation: 一个可能解释是更易参与的课程让规律身体活动更容易融入日常作息。

examples.sentenceText: One possible explanation is that cheaper handsets and wider network coverage made mobile services easier to access in developing countries.
examples.translation: 一种可能的解释是，更便宜的手机与更广的网络覆盖，让发展中国家的移动服务更易获取。

bindings.条件: cheaper handsets and wider network coverage

sentencePatterns.pattern: [短期成效] creates an opportunity, but [长期条件] are what [真正作用].
sentencePatterns.function: 区分首次成果与持续成功条件
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 动名词作主语；but转折；what从句作表语。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 长期条件必须具体，不能用同义褒义词反复修饰。

examples.sentenceText: Winning market share creates an opportunity, but reliable performance and effective after-sales service are what encourage customers to return.
examples.translation: 赢得市场份额带来机会，但可靠性能与有效售后才会促使顾客再次选择。

bindings.长期条件: reliable performance and effective after-sales service

sentencePatterns.pattern: [条件A] and [条件B] help [目标] for both [主体A] and [主体B].
sentencePatterns.function: 解释基础设施对不同主体的共同收益
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 并列主语help加动词原形；both…and并列受益者。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 两类主体应确实从同一机制受益。

examples.sentenceText: Better transport links and reliable delivery help expand market access for both rural buyers and local producers.
examples.translation: 更好的交通联系和可靠配送有助于扩大农村买家与当地生产者的市场接入。

sentencePatterns.pattern: [能力], however, does not arise merely because [表面条件]; it requires [必要条件].
sentencePatterns.function: 区分表面形式与实质能力条件
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: does not arise merely because限定原因；分号后给真正条件。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 低收益比例可提示改进方向，不证明活动完全无效。

examples.sentenceText: Cooperation, however, does not arise merely because students work in the same place; it requires shared goals and meaningful dependence on one another.
examples.translation: 但合作不会仅因学生在同一地点工作就产生，它需要共同目标与真实的相互依赖。

bindings.表面条件: students work in the same place
bindings.必要条件: shared goals and meaningful dependence on one another

examples.sentenceText: Understanding, however, does not arise merely because a text is accessible; it requires sustained attention.
examples.translation: 然而，理解不会仅因文本容易获取而自然产生；它需要持续专注。

sentencePatterns.pattern: Understanding why [需要理解的内容] matters, for example, is more likely to [真正效果] than merely [表面行为].
sentencePatterns.function: 比较理解与机械记忆的作用
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 动名词结构作主语；more likely…than…作比较。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 保持两项可比，不写任何记忆都无价值。

examples.sentenceText: Understanding why a habit matters, for example, is more likely to support informed choices than merely remembering a slogan.
examples.translation: 例如，理解一个习惯为何重要，比只记住一句口号更能支持有依据的选择。

sentencePatterns.pattern: The same [工具] that [便利] also delivers [限制], making [必要条件] an essential part of [任务].
sentencePatterns.function: 说明同一工具的便利与限制
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: that修饰device；making写由此产生的注意力要求。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 限制应来自同一工具机制，不生硬加入无关弊端。

examples.sentenceText: The same device that opens a useful text also delivers messages and distractions, making concentration an essential part of effective mobile learning.
examples.translation: 打开有用文本的同一设备，也带来消息与干扰，使专注成为有效手机学习的必要部分。

examples.sentenceText: The same device that provides digital resources also delivers messages and distractions that can put pressure on attention, making sustained attention an essential part of independent learning.
examples.translation: 提供数字资源的同一设备也会带来给注意力造成压力的消息与干扰，因此持续专注成为自主学习的重要部分。

bindings.限制: messages and distractions that can put pressure on attention

sentencePatterns.pattern: When [参与条件], [活动] can help them [收益行动].
sentencePatterns.function: 在具体条件下呈现活动的综合收益
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: When给出参与情境；help后并列动词原形。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不能把潜在收益写成每个参与者都已获得。

examples.sentenceText: When adults and children explore together, a family workshop can help them observe closely, exchange questions and strengthen family ties.
examples.translation: 成人与儿童共同探索时，家庭工作坊能帮助他们仔细观察、交流问题并增进家庭联系。

bindings.收益行动: observe closely, exchange questions and strengthen family ties

examples.sentenceText: When students plant, repair or produce something, practical work can help them connect instructions with actions and respond to results.
examples.translation: 学生种植、修理或制作东西时，实践工作能帮助他们把指令与行动联系起来，并根据结果作出回应。

bindings.参与条件: students plant, repair or produce something
bindings.收益行动: connect instructions with actions and respond to results

sentencePatterns.pattern: [较低指标] need not reduce their value: [价值A], and [价值B].
sentencePatterns.function: 避免由低参与率推导低价值
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: need not表示未必；冒号后举两项具体价值。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不否认参与率事实，而区分条件与价值。

examples.sentenceText: Their lower participation rates need not reduce their value: reading can stimulate thought, and a game of chess can provide both mental challenge and social contact.
examples.translation: 参与率较低不应降低它们的价值：阅读激发思考，下棋兼具智力挑战与社会交往。

bindings.价值B: a game of chess can provide both mental challenge and social contact

sentencePatterns.pattern: Continued progress should therefore concern [质量目标], not [数量指标] alone.
sentencePatterns.function: 由规模增长转向质量标准
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: should concern…not…alone给出发展评价重点。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 先描述数量意义，再说明怎样改善质量。

examples.sentenceText: Continued progress should therefore concern the quality of encounters, not visitor totals alone.
examples.translation: 因此，持续进步应关注体验质量，而不只看参观总量。

examples.sentenceText: Continued progress should therefore concern lasting benefits, not volume alone.
examples.translation: 因此，持续进步应着眼于持久收益，而不只关注业务量。

sentencePatterns.pattern: [针对性行动] is more likely to [目标] than [无效做法].
sentencePatterns.function: 用效果比较支持针对性措施
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 两个动名词短语作比较；than后不是无主长句。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 需要说明哪些关切、怎样回应，而非空喊针对性。

examples.sentenceText: Addressing specific concerns is more likely to improve morale than providing benefits that overlook what employees actually need.
examples.translation: 回应具体关切，比提供忽视真实需要的福利更有可能提升士气。

bindings.无效做法: providing benefits that overlook what employees actually need

examples.sentenceText: Combining distinctive strengths with dependable performance is more likely to earn repeat visits than relying on novelty alone.
examples.translation: 把鲜明特色与可靠表现结合起来，比仅依赖新奇感更可能赢得再次光顾。

bindings.针对性行动: Combining distinctive strengths with dependable performance

sentencePatterns.pattern: [主体], in turn, should consider what [选择对象] [非金钱收益] as well as what it [直接收益].
sentencePatterns.function: 为选择提出双重评价标准
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: what从句平行作consider宾语；in turn承接高校责任。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不否定收入的重要性，只增加学习价值维度。

examples.sentenceText: Students, in turn, should consider what a job teaches them as well as what it pays.
examples.translation: 学生也应既考虑工作教会自己什么，也考虑报酬。

sentencePatterns.pattern: No [路径] is automatically superior: [选择A] is valuable when [条件A], just as [选择B] is valuable when [条件B].
sentencePatterns.function: 用一致标准评价不同道路
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 冒号解释判断；just as作类比；两个when限定价值条件。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不是宣称所有选项完全等价，而看是否匹配目的。

examples.sentenceText: No route is automatically superior: further study is valuable when it serves a clear purpose, just as a job is valuable when it offers suitable prospects for development.
examples.translation: 没有哪条路天然更好：深造因服务明确目的而有价值，工作则因提供适合的发展前景而有价值。

bindings.条件B: it offers suitable prospects for development

sentencePatterns.pattern: [主体] can help by [措施A], [措施B] and [措施C].
sentencePatterns.function: 用具体条件扩大参与机会
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: by后接三个动名词短语，结构平行。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 每项措施应回应前文的一种限制。

examples.sentenceText: Communities can help by maintaining safe paths, providing comfortable reading spaces and making it easy to find activity partners.
examples.translation: 社区可维护安全步道、提供舒适阅读空间，并让寻找活动伙伴更容易。

bindings.措施C: making it easy to find activity partners

examples.sentenceText: Public education can help by using plain language, presenting familiar situations and helping people distinguish sound advice from misleading claims.
examples.translation: 公共教育可以通过使用通俗语言、呈现熟悉情境，并帮助人们区分可靠建议与误导性说法发挥作用。

bindings.措施C: helping people distinguish sound advice from misleading claims

sentencePatterns.pattern: Growth is most meaningful when it [积极结果] without [避免代价].
sentencePatterns.function: 以收益和代价共同评价增长
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: when引出有价值的条件；without接动名词。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不要把规模直接等同于进步。

examples.sentenceText: Growth is most meaningful when it makes trade more accessible without shifting unreasonable costs onto people or the environment.
examples.translation: 增长在便利交易，又不把不合理成本转嫁给人或环境时最有意义。

bindings.避免代价: shifting unreasonable costs onto people or the environment

sentencePatterns.pattern: [主体] also need [支持] so that [行为] remains a choice rather than a necessity.
sentencePatterns.function: 让行动保持为选择而非被迫
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: so that说明配套投入的目的；rather than比较选择与必要。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 不否定自愿迁移，重点在替代机会。

examples.sentenceText: Rural areas also need investment so that migration remains a choice rather than a necessity.
examples.translation: 农村也需要投入，使迁移是一种选择，而非迫不得已。

sentencePatterns.pattern: In my view, [行为] is worthwhile when it [价值] without [避免代价].
sentencePatterns.function: 在保留价值的同时控制成本
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: when与without分别限定收益和成本。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 花钱多少不是关系质量唯一标准。

examples.sentenceText: In my view, festive spending is worthwhile when it strengthens relationships without creating financial strain.
examples.translation: 我认为，节日花销在增进关系又不制造经济负担时值得。

examples.sentenceText: In my view, festive spending is worthwhile when it respects family priorities without creating financial strain.
examples.translation: 在我看来，节日支出若能尊重家庭优先事项，又不造成经济负担，就是值得的。

sentencePatterns.pattern: [主体] can [设计] and ask students to reflect on both [反思A] and [反思B].
sentencePatterns.function: 把任务设计与反馈反思结合
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: can后并列assign和ask；both…and并列反思对象。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 合作不是仅共处，分工要有真实互补。

examples.sentenceText: Projects can assign complementary responsibilities and ask students to reflect on both their results and their collaboration.
examples.translation: 项目可分配互补职责，并要求学生反思结果与协作。

examples.sentenceText: Teachers can design projects and ask students to reflect on both their understanding and their joint responsibilities.
examples.translation: 教师可以设计项目，并请学生同时反思自己的理解与共同责任。

sentencePatterns.pattern: [条件A], [条件B] and [条件C] can make [对象] [结果].
sentencePatterns.function: 用并列行动说明如何提升活动或服务价值
sentencePatterns.grammarNote: 三个动名词短语作并列主语；make接宾语和补足语。
sentencePatterns.usageNote: 三项具体行动须共同支持所述效果；儿童活动兼顾指导与探索，服务场景则对应稳定质量与信任。

examples.sentenceText: Choosing safe surroundings, listening to questions and allowing time to observe can make ordinary outings valuable.
examples.translation: 选择安全环境、倾听问题、给足观察时间，可以让普通外出有价值。

examples.sentenceText: Training staff, checking ingredients and listening to complaints can make a restaurant more trustworthy.
examples.translation: 培训员工、检查食材并倾听投诉，可以让餐厅更值得信赖。

exampleSentences.text: Your thoughtful arrangements and warm hospitality made me feel welcome throughout the exchange.
exampleSentences.translation: 你周到的安排与热情款待，让我在整个交流期间都感到受到欢迎。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 感谢与具体收获：用安排和款待说明交流体验。

exampleSentences.text: It would be a pleasure to return your kindness by showing you around my city and introducing you to our traditions and local food.
exampleSentences.translation: 我很乐意带你游览我的城市，介绍我们的传统和当地食物，以回报你的好意。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 回访邀请：by后用可提供的具体帮助回应好意。

exampleSentences.text: I know how much effort you have put into this goal, and I am delighted that it has paid off.
exampleSentences.translation: 我知道你为这个目标付出了很多努力，很高兴努力得到了回报。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 回应喜讯：把付出与成功联系起来。

exampleSentences.text: University learning calls for greater independence, so getting used to organizing your own time will help.
exampleSentences.translation: 大学学习要求更强的独立性，因此习惯自行安排时间会有帮助。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 准备建议：用大学学习的要求解释时间管理。

exampleSentences.text: The screen repeatedly goes blank, and several keys fail to respond, making the dictionary unusable for my studies.
exampleSentences.translation: 屏幕反复变为空白，几个按键也没有反应，导致词典无法用于学习。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 故障描述：用两项可观察的问题说明影响。

exampleSentences.text: If this cannot be arranged promptly, please issue a full refund and advise me how to return the faulty item.
exampleSentences.translation: 若无法及时安排，请全额退款，并告知怎样退回故障商品。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 补救要求：在无法换货时提出退款与退货安排。

exampleSentences.text: Our class is holding a charity sale to support children in need, and I warmly invite you to take part in the event.
exampleSentences.translation: 我们班将举办义卖，支持有需要的儿童，诚邀大家参加。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 活动动员：同时交代义卖目的与参与邀请。

exampleSentences.text: If you have nothing to donate, you can still help by setting up stalls or serving customers.
exampleSentences.translation: 若没有可捐物品，也能帮忙搭建摊位或接待顾客。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 替代参与方式：无法捐物时也可贡献时间。

exampleSentences.text: I prefer a quiet study environment, keep shared spaces tidy and am happy to share responsibilities for the housework.
exampleSentences.translation: 我喜欢安静的学习环境，会保持公共区域整洁，也愿意分担家务责任。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 生活说明：并列介绍环境偏好、整洁习惯和家务责任。

exampleSentences.text: Could you suggest affordable places to shop and the easiest way to get to campus?
exampleSentences.translation: 你能推荐价格实惠的购物地点，以及去校园最方便的方式吗？
exampleSentences.shortNote: 具体询问：让购物与通学问题容易回复。

exampleSentences.text: Volunteer duties will include welcoming students, leading tours and assisting with activities.
exampleSentences.translation: 志愿者职责包括迎接学生、带领参观并协助活动。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 职责说明：用三个动名词明确志愿者任务。

exampleSentences.text: Please submit an application with a brief introduction and your contact details to the Students’ Union by June 10.
exampleSentences.translation: 请于六月十日前向学生会提交申请，附简短介绍与联系方式。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 申请安排：写清材料、渠道和截止时间。

exampleSentences.text: A translation must sound natural as well as convey the original meaning.
exampleSentences.translation: 译文既要自然，也要传达原意。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 评价标准：兼顾表达自然与忠实原意。

exampleSentences.text: Keep a record of useful expressions and recurring mistakes to make each exercise more rewarding.
exampleSentences.translation: 记录有用表达和反复出现的错误，让每次练习更有收获。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 练习方法：记录有用表达和反复错误，以便改进。

exampleSentences.text: My presentation will focus on the Spring Festival and the meaning of family reunion.
exampleSentences.translation: 演讲将聚焦春节及家庭团聚的意义。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 演讲主题：聚焦一个节日及其文化意义。

exampleSentences.text: Please let me know the time available for the talk so that I can adjust the presentation accordingly.
exampleSentences.translation: 请告知演讲可用时长，以便我相应调整内容。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 安排询问：说明为什么需要了解演讲时长。

exampleSentences.text: Knowing that you have set aside time for me, I sincerely apologize for disrupting your arrangements.
exampleSentences.translation: 想到您已专门为我留出时间，我为打乱您的安排诚恳道歉。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 承认影响后道歉：分词结构的主语必须与I一致。

exampleSentences.text: If another date would suit you better, I will gladly adjust my plans.
exampleSentences.translation: 若其他日期更合适，我很愿意调整计划。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 替代安排：把时间偏好留给对方并承诺配合。

exampleSentences.text: The topic balances concerns about congestion and pollution against people’s need for convenient transport, giving both sides substantial arguments.
exampleSentences.translation: 该题将拥堵与污染的顾虑，同便利交通的需求放在一起权衡，使双方都有充分可辩的理由。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 选题理由：呈现交通议题中相互竞争的关切。

exampleSentences.text: Two teams of four students will present opposing views, exchange questions and give closing statements.
exampleSentences.translation: 两队各四名学生将陈述对立观点、相互提问并作总结陈词。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 流程安排：三项并列任务形成清楚的辩论程序。

exampleSentences.text: Its grand halls and courtyards offer a fascinating introduction to traditional architecture and imperial life.
exampleSentences.translation: 宏伟的殿堂与庭院，为了解传统建筑和宫廷生活提供了生动入口。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 景点介绍：用具体建筑特色连接文化和历史。

exampleSentences.text: To make the most of the visit, please read a brief introduction in advance and note any questions you would like to ask.
exampleSentences.translation: 为了充分利用此次参观，请提前阅读简短介绍，记下想提的问题。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 行前建议：把提前阅读与提问联系到参观收获。

exampleSentences.text: I would like to invite you to an online meeting on adapting to university life, scheduled for 3 p.m. next Saturday.
exampleSentences.translation: 我想邀请你参加下周六下午三点举行的线上会议，主题是适应大学生活。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 邀请信息：在一句中交代主题、形式与时间。

exampleSentences.text: It would be wonderful if you could share one challenge you encountered and how you dealt with it.
exampleSentences.translation: 若你能分享一个遇到的困难及应对办法，那就太好了。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 参与任务：委婉请对方分享一个挑战及解决方法。

exampleSentences.text: You can sample regional dishes, hear the stories behind them and watch a dumpling-making demonstration.
exampleSentences.translation: 你们可以品尝地方菜肴、了解背后故事，并观看包饺子示范。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 活动内容：用三项具体体验展示美食节的吸引力。

exampleSentences.text: It would be wonderful if you could introduce a favourite dish from your own country.
exampleSentences.translation: 如果你们能介绍一道自己国家喜爱的菜肴，那就太好了。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 参与邀请：请来宾提供本国菜肴，形成双向交流。

exampleSentences.text: It offers a chance to see technology in action rather than simply read about it.
exampleSentences.translation: 它让你看到技术实际运用，而不只是读到有关介绍。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 推荐理由：说明现场体验相对只读文字的价值。

exampleSentences.text: You could also ask questions about how the robots work and consider where human judgement is still needed.
exampleSentences.translation: 你也可以询问机器人原理，思考哪些地方仍需要人的判断。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 学习行动：把提问与判断人类作用连接起来。

exampleSentences.text: For our survey on old-house protection, I suggest combining field observations with interviews so that we can understand both the buildings’ condition and residents’ concerns.
exampleSentences.translation: 关于我们的老屋保护调查，我建议把实地观察与访谈结合，以同时了解建筑状况和居民关切。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 调查方法：建议与目的从句相互对应。

exampleSentences.text: I can draft the observation checklist while you prepare interview questions; afterwards, we can compare our findings.
exampleSentences.translation: 我拟观察清单，你准备访谈问题，随后我们共同比较发现。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 合作分工：用while分配任务，再汇总发现。

exampleSentences.text: I am putting together a short play based on Journey to the West and would love you to join the cast.
exampleSentences.translation: 我正在筹备一部根据《西游记》改编的短剧，很希望你加入演员阵容。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 邀请目的：交代短剧来源并邀请加入。

exampleSentences.text: Through their disagreements and eventual cooperation, the story explores what it means to be a good teammate.
exampleSentences.translation: 故事通过人物的分歧与最终合作，探讨怎样才算好队友。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 主题说明：通过冲突与合作概括故事意义。

exampleSentences.text: I thoroughly enjoyed it: seeing the journey through your eyes made familiar surroundings feel fresh again.
exampleSentences.translation: 我很喜欢：通过你的视角看旅程，让熟悉的环境也重新显得新鲜。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 观看感受：用具体视角解释为什么觉得新鲜。

exampleSentences.text: Which place left the strongest impression on you, and why?
exampleSentences.translation: 哪个地方给你印象最深，为什么？
exampleSentences.shortNote: 后续追问：围绕同一经历询问感受及理由。

exampleSentences.text: In developing countries, subscriptions showed a sharp increase from well below 1 billion to 4 billion, whereas developed countries recorded a much gentler rise to approximately 1 billion.
exampleSentences.translation: 发展中国家的订阅量由远低于十亿大幅增至四十亿，发达国家则缓慢增至约十亿。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 对照数据：区分订阅量与用户人数，并准确比较增长。

exampleSentences.text: One possible explanation is that cheaper handsets and wider network coverage made mobile services easier to access in developing countries.
exampleSentences.translation: 一种可能的解释是，更便宜的手机与更广的网络覆盖，让发展中国家的移动服务更易获取。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 可能解释：设备与覆盖降低服务获取门槛。

exampleSentences.text: The chart shows a reversal in ranking between Chinese and Japanese car brands from 2008 to 2009.
exampleSentences.translation: 图表显示2008至2009年国产与日系汽车品牌排名逆转。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 数据概括：用排名逆转提炼核心变化。

exampleSentences.text: Winning market share creates an opportunity, but reliable performance and effective after-sales service are what encourage customers to return.
exampleSentences.translation: 赢得市场份额带来机会，但可靠性能与有效售后才会促使顾客再次选择。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 条件评论：区分初次赢得份额与持续留客。

exampleSentences.text: Among employees aged 41 to 50, 64% are dissatisfied and none are satisfied.
exampleSentences.translation: 41至50岁员工中，64%不满意，无人表示满意。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 组内数据：不满意与满意比例不必互补到100%。

exampleSentences.text: Addressing specific concerns is more likely to improve morale than providing benefits that overlook what employees actually need.
exampleSentences.translation: 回应具体关切，比提供忽视真实需要的福利更有可能提升士气。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 针对性措施：用效果比较支持回应具体需求。

exampleSentences.text: It reaches 88.24% in the final year, making graduating students the most active participants by a considerable margin.
exampleSentences.translation: 大四达到88.24%，毕业年级以明显差距成为参与最积极的群体。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 突出比较：明确最高参与率及对应年级。

exampleSentences.text: As graduation approaches, practical experience becomes more valuable: students need to test career interests, develop transferable skills and demonstrate their abilities to employers.
exampleSentences.translation: 随着毕业临近，实践经验更有价值：学生需要探索职业兴趣、发展可迁移技能，并向雇主展示能力。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 阶段解释：说明毕业临近为何带来实践需求。

exampleSentences.text: The urban population more than doubled, rising from 300 million to 666 million, while the rural population declined from 834 million to 674 million.
exampleSentences.translation: 城镇人口由三亿增至六亿六千六百万，达到两倍以上；乡村人口则由八亿三千四百万降至六亿七千四百万。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 相反走势：同句表达超过翻倍与下降。

exampleSentences.text: Rural areas also need investment so that migration remains a choice rather than a necessity.
exampleSentences.translation: 农村也需要投入，使迁移是一种选择，而非迫不得已。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 配套评论：让迁移保持为选择，需要另一地区的机会。

exampleSentences.text: Gifts take the largest share, at 40%, while transport, meals with family and friends, and other expenses each account for 20%.
exampleSentences.translation: 礼物占最大份额40%，交通、亲友聚餐及其他支出各20%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 构成数据：交代最大项与三个同占比项目。

exampleSentences.text: In my view, festive spending is worthwhile when it strengthens relationships without creating financial strain.
exampleSentences.translation: 我认为，节日花销在增进关系又不制造经济负担时值得。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 条件评价：关系收益与可承受成本同时考虑。

exampleSentences.text: Together, sightseeing and relaxation account for seven out of every ten responses.
exampleSentences.translation: 观景与放松合计占每十份回答中的七份。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 合并概括：把两个互斥目的的份额相加。

exampleSentences.text: Travel offers a temporary escape from familiar pressures, while natural surroundings provide pleasure that everyday routines may lack.
exampleSentences.translation: 旅游让学生暂离熟悉压力，自然环境也提供日常作息可能缺少的乐趣。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 机制解释：环境变化与压力恢复共同满足旅行需要。

exampleSentences.text: Museum numbers rose from about 4,200 to 4,700, while annual visits increased from approximately 640 million to 780 million.
exampleSentences.translation: 博物馆约由4200家升至4700家，年参观人次由约6.4亿增至7.8亿。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 双指标变化：区分场馆数量与参观人次单位。

exampleSentences.text: Continued progress should therefore concern the quality of encounters, not visitor totals alone.
exampleSentences.translation: 因此，持续进步应关注体验质量，而不只看参观总量。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 质量评论：数量进步后仍需关注接触体验。

exampleSentences.text: Price accounts for less than a tenth, at 8.4%, while other factors represent 4.7%.
exampleSentences.translation: 价格占不到十分之一，为8.4%，其他因素为4.7%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 较小份额：近似概括后给出准确数值。

exampleSentences.text: Combining distinctive strengths with dependable performance is more likely to earn repeat visits than relying on novelty alone.
exampleSentences.translation: 把鲜明特色与可靠表现结合起来，比仅依赖新奇感更可能赢得再次光顾。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 效果比较：以稳定表现解释为何不能只靠新奇留客。

exampleSentences.text: Employment remained the largest category, although its share fell from 68.1% to 60.7%.
exampleSentences.translation: 就业仍是最大类别，尽管份额由68.1%降至60.7%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 让步概括：份额下降仍可保持最大类别。

exampleSentences.text: No route is automatically superior: further study is valuable when it serves a clear purpose, just as a job is valuable when it offers suitable prospects for development.
exampleSentences.translation: 没有哪条路天然更好：深造因服务明确目的而有价值，工作则因提供适合的发展前景而有价值。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 选择标准：用相同条件评价两条道路。

exampleSentences.text: Learning accounts for 59.5%, well ahead of passing the time at 21.3% and obtaining information at 17%.
exampleSentences.translation: 学习占59.5%，明显高于消磨时间21.3%与获取信息17%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 主要类别：用显著领先概括学习目的。

exampleSentences.text: The same device that opens a useful text also delivers messages and distractions, making concentration an essential part of effective mobile learning.
exampleSentences.translation: 打开有用文本的同一设备，也带来消息与干扰，使专注成为有效手机学习的必要部分。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 机制限制：同一设备同时带来便利与干扰。

exampleSentences.text: Just over half (54.3%) report exercising alone, followed by 47.7% who exercise with friends.
exampleSentences.translation: 略超一半即54.3%报告独自锻炼，其次为47.7%与朋友锻炼。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 调查方式：report说明参与方式，不擅自改成偏好。

exampleSentences.text: A routine that people enjoy and maintain matters more than whether they follow it alone or in company.
exampleSentences.translation: 让人喜欢且能坚持的习惯，比独自还是结伴实行更重要。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 评价标准：能否享受并长期坚持比方式本身更重要。

exampleSentences.text: Particularly striking is the doubling of rural volume from 2019 to 2020.
exampleSentences.translation: 尤其突出的是农村业务量在2019至2020年翻倍。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 突出变化：倒装用于强调确有依据的翻倍阶段。

exampleSentences.text: Growth is most meaningful when it makes trade more accessible without shifting unreasonable costs onto people or the environment.
exampleSentences.translation: 增长在便利交易，又不把不合理成本转嫁给人或环境时最有意义。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 条件评论：用收益与避免代价共同评价增长。

exampleSentences.text: The proportion rose from 8.80% to 25.40%, with growth becoming more pronounced in later years.
exampleSentences.translation: 比例由8.80%升至25.40%，后期增长更明显。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 阶段走势：with结构补充后期增长更显著。

exampleSentences.text: Public education can help by using plain language, presenting familiar situations and helping people distinguish sound advice from misleading claims.
exampleSentences.translation: 公共教育可以通过使用通俗语言、呈现熟悉情境，并帮助人们区分可靠建议与误导性说法发挥作用。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 具体措施：通俗语言、熟悉情境与辨别训练共同服务理解。

exampleSentences.text: Acquiring knowledge leads at 91.3%, closely followed by improved practical skills at 84.8%.
exampleSentences.translation: 获取知识以91.3%领先，动手技能提升84.8%紧随其后。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 接近数据：closely followed by适用于差距较小的前两项。

exampleSentences.text: Cooperation, however, does not arise merely because students work in the same place; it requires shared goals and meaningful dependence on one another.
exampleSentences.translation: 但合作不会仅因学生在同一地点工作就产生，它需要共同目标与真实的相互依赖。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 必要条件：共处不自动产生合作，须有目标与依赖。

exampleSentences.text: Television is most common at 90.8%, followed by walking at 68.3%.
exampleSentences.translation: 看电视最普遍，为90.8%，其次为散步68.3%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 主要活动：描述最常见与其次的参与率。

exampleSentences.text: Communities can help by maintaining safe paths, providing comfortable reading spaces and making it easy to find activity partners.
exampleSentences.translation: 社区可维护安全步道、提供舒适阅读空间，并让寻找活动伙伴更容易。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 扩大选择：三项具体措施回应空间与同伴需求。

exampleSentences.text: Satisfying curiosity and developing observation skills receive almost identical support, at 54.6% and 54.5%.
exampleSentences.translation: 满足好奇心与促进观察力得到几乎相同的支持，分别为54.6%与54.5%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 近似相等：不夸大仅0.1个百分点的差别。

exampleSentences.text: Choosing safe surroundings, listening to questions and allowing time to observe can make ordinary outings valuable.
exampleSentences.translation: 选择安全环境、倾听问题、给足观察时间，可以让普通外出有价值。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 活动设计：安全、倾听与观察共同提升活动价值。

exampleSentences.text: Your advice meant a great deal: it helped me understand my options and decide what to do next.
exampleSentences.translation: 你的建议意义重大，让我理解了可选道路，并决定下一步行动。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 感谢价值：把抽象谢意落实为理解选项和决定行动。

exampleSentences.text: In return, I would love to welcome you to China and introduce you to my city.
exampleSentences.translation: 作为回报，我很愿意欢迎你来中国，带你了解我的城市。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 友好回报：在感谢之后提出可实际兑现的邀请。

exampleSentences.text: Our cultural presentation day will serve as a platform for students to exchange stories and practise public speaking.
exampleSentences.translation: 文化展示日将为学生交流故事、练习公众表达提供平台。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 活动目的：serve as a platform后说明学生能够做什么。

exampleSentences.text: Volunteers will welcome visitors, organize materials and create a welcoming atmosphere.
exampleSentences.translation: 志愿者将迎接来访者、整理材料并营造友好氛围。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 志愿任务：用迎接、整理与营造氛围具体说明服务。

exampleSentences.text: To make steady progress, set realistic goals and build a manageable routine rather than translate long passages occasionally.
exampleSentences.translation: 要稳步进步，应设定现实目标、建立可坚持的安排，而非偶尔翻译长文。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 目标与日常安排：用rather than对照稳定练习与偶尔用力。

exampleSentences.text: Seek meaningful feedback to identify your weaknesses, then put what you learn into practice in the next exercise.
exampleSentences.translation: 寻求有实际帮助的反馈来发现薄弱处，再把所学用于下一次练习。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 反馈与应用：先识别薄弱处，再把所学用于下次练习。

exampleSentences.text: Knowing that you have set aside time for me, I sincerely apologize for disrupting your arrangements by changing our meeting.
exampleSentences.translation: 知道您已为我留出时间，我为更改会面、打乱您的安排诚恳致歉。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 改约道歉：先承认对方为会面留出的时间。

exampleSentences.text: If the following week would suit you better, I will gladly meet at your convenience.
exampleSentences.translation: 如果下一周对您更合适，我很乐意在您方便时会面。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 替代时段：明确次周选择，并保留对方时间偏好。

exampleSentences.text: I am writing about your online writing course, which has failed to meet the stated standard.
exampleSentences.translation: 我就贵方在线写作课程来信，课程未达到所声明的标准。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 投诉对象：非限制性定语从句直接点明未达标准。

exampleSentences.text: Please resolve the matter by restoring the lessons at no additional cost and providing the promised feedback, or offer an appropriate refund.
exampleSentences.translation: 请免费补齐课程并提供承诺的反馈，或作出合理退款，以解决此事。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 补救要求：提出免费补齐与反馈，或合理退款。

exampleSentences.text: For our investigation, I suggest making field observations and conducting interviews so that we can collect reliable evidence and identify common concerns.
exampleSentences.translation: 对于这次调查，我建议开展实地观察与访谈，以便收集可靠依据并找出共同关切。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 方法与目的：观察、访谈分别服务证据和共同关切。

exampleSentences.text: Let us share responsibilities: I will prepare a draft of the checklist while you design questions about costs and local traditions.
exampleSentences.translation: 我们分担职责：我起草记录清单，你设计关于成本和地方传统的问题。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 合作安排：分配清单与问卷任务，而非空喊共同努力。

exampleSentences.text: Starting at 10%, the rate reached a peak of 60%, with a sharp increase between 2019 and 2020.
exampleSentences.translation: 参与率由10%升至60%，2019至2020年间大幅增加。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 阶段数据：区分区间最高点与增长最明显的阶段。

exampleSentences.text: One possible explanation is that more accessible sessions made regular physical activity easier to fit into daily routines.
exampleSentences.translation: 一个可能解释是更易参与的课程让规律身体活动更容易融入日常作息。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 可能机制：可达性降低坚持规律活动的门槛。

exampleSentences.text: Digital reading rose steadily from two to six hours weekly; the corresponding figure for print declined gradually from six to two.
exampleSentences.translation: 电子阅读由每周两小时稳步升至六小时，纸质阅读的对应数值由六小时逐渐降至两小时。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 相反走势：对应数值需要同样的时长单位。

exampleSentences.text: Yet choosing a screen does not necessarily mean abandoning deep reading, just as choosing paper does not guarantee concentration.
exampleSentences.translation: 但选择屏幕未必意味着放弃深入阅读，正如选择纸张也不保证专注。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 限制推断：屏幕与纸张都不能单凭形式保证理解。

exampleSentences.text: Food quality ranks first in this survey, selected by 56% of respondents.
exampleSentences.translation: 食品质量在此调查中排名第一，56%的受访者选择该项。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 调查排名：排名与56%的选择比例共同描述主要理由。

exampleSentences.text: Training staff, checking ingredients and listening to complaints can make a restaurant more trustworthy.
exampleSentences.translation: 培训员工、检查食材并倾听投诉，可以让餐厅更值得信赖。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 服务措施：并列行动与make宾补说明如何建立信任。

exampleSentences.text: The survey reports gains from a practical course: 82% mention skills, 70% subject knowledge and 45% teamwork.
exampleSentences.translation: 调查报告实践课程收获：82%提及技能，70%提及学科知识，45%提及团队合作。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 多选数据：不同收获比例可重叠，不能相加当总人数。

exampleSentences.text: Teachers can design projects and ask students to reflect on both their understanding and their joint responsibilities.
exampleSentences.translation: 教师可以设计项目，并请学生同时反思自己的理解与共同责任。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 教学建议：把项目设计与个人理解、共同责任的反思相连。

exampleSentences.text: The survey asks what matters most in choosing a future path: interests lead at 48%, followed by development opportunities at 35% and starting income at 17%.
exampleSentences.translation: 调查询问未来道路选择中最重要的因素：兴趣48%领先，其次为发展机会35%和起薪17%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 因素排序：交代首要关切及其余两项份额。

exampleSentences.text: Practical placements can broaden their perspective, help them assess personal strengths and identify their weaknesses.
exampleSentences.translation: 实践岗位可拓宽他们的视野，帮助评估个人优势并发现薄弱处。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 探索机制：岗位体验联系视野、优势与薄弱处。

exampleSentences.text: The chart distinguishes three abilities: 78% of residents can find health information, 56% can explain it and 34% can apply it to a decision.
exampleSentences.translation: 图表区分三项能力：78%居民能找到健康信息，56%能解释，34%能用于决策。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 能力差距：获取、理解和应用分开描述。

exampleSentences.text: Health education should therefore use plain language and familiar situations, asking residents to explain how advice applies to a concrete example.
exampleSentences.translation: 因此，健康教育应使用通俗语言和熟悉情境，请居民解释建议如何用于具体例子。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 教育方法：让居民用具体情境说明建议的含义。

exampleSentences.text: A survey identifies interruptions as the main reading difficulty for 52% of students, followed by choosing materials at 29% and finding time at 19%.
exampleSentences.translation: 调查中，52%学生认为干扰是主要阅读困难，其次为选择材料29%与寻找时间19%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 困难构成：描述主要问题并列出其余比例。

exampleSentences.text: The same device that provides digital resources also delivers messages and distractions that can put pressure on attention, making sustained attention an essential part of independent learning.
exampleSentences.translation: 提供数字资源的同一设备也会带来给注意力造成压力的消息与干扰，因此持续专注成为自主学习的重要部分。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 工具的双重作用：资源便利与消息干扰共同解释专注要求。

exampleSentences.text: The survey reports three main benefits of a cultural centre: learning at 65%, social contact at 58% and confidence at 41%.
exampleSentences.translation: 调查报告文化中心的三项主要收益：学习65%、社会交往58%、自信41%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 多项收益：比例可重叠，不能作互斥份额相加。

exampleSentences.text: When adults and children explore together, a family workshop can help them observe closely, exchange questions and strengthen family ties.
exampleSentences.translation: 成人与儿童共同探索时，家庭工作坊能帮助他们仔细观察、交流问题并增进家庭联系。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 条件与实例：家庭共同探索怎样连接观察和亲子关系。

exampleSentences.text: The chart shows county deliveries more than doubling from two million parcels in 2020 to five million in 2024, alongside growth in collection points from 40 to 85.
exampleSentences.translation: 图表显示县域快递由2020年200万件增至2024年500万件，达到两倍以上；取件点同时由40个增至85个。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 双指标变化：包裹量与网点数量使用不同单位。

exampleSentences.text: Continued progress should therefore concern lasting benefits, not volume alone.
exampleSentences.translation: 因此，持续进步应着眼于持久收益，而不只关注业务量。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 质量评价：用持久收益评价进步，不止看业务量。

exampleSentences.text: The chart shows gift spending falling to a low of 20% in 2020 before recovering to 25% in 2024, compared with 30% in 2018.
exampleSentences.translation: 图表显示礼物支出在2020年降至20%的低点，之后回升至2024年25%，而2018年为30%。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 先降后升：低点与恢复后的水平要区分。

exampleSentences.text: In my view, festive spending is worthwhile when it respects family priorities without creating financial strain.
exampleSentences.translation: 在我看来，节日支出若能尊重家庭优先事项，又不造成经济负担，就是值得的。
exampleSentences.shortNote: 条件评论：家庭取舍与经济承受能力共同限定值得的支出。

essays.title: 2010年英语二·感谢接待与欢迎访华

sentences.text: Dear Alex,
sentences.translation: 亲爱的Alex：

sentences.text: Now that I am back in China, I would like to thank you for making my visit so rewarding.
sentences.translation: 如今我已回到中国，想感谢你让此次访问如此有收获。

sentences.text: Your thoughtful arrangements and warm hospitality made me feel welcome throughout the exchange.
sentences.translation: 你周到的安排与热情款待，让我在整个交流期间都感到受到欢迎。

sentences.text: I particularly enjoyed our conversations about everyday life.
sentences.translation: 我尤其喜欢我们关于日常生活的交谈。

sentences.text: They brought American culture to life in a way that books never could.
sentences.translation: 这些交流让美国文化变得鲜活，这是书本无法做到的。

sentences.text: I hope you will visit China when time permits.
sentences.translation: 希望你在时间允许时来中国。

sentences.text: It would be a pleasure to return your kindness by showing you around my city and introducing you to our traditions and local food.
sentences.translation: 我很乐意带你游览我的城市，介绍我们的传统和当地食物，以回报你的好意。

sentences.text: Such a memorable experience meant a great deal: it helped me understand American culture and appreciate your kindness.
sentences.translation: 如此难忘的经历意义重大：它让我理解了美国文化，也让我更珍惜你的好意。

sentences.text: Do keep in touch.
sentences.translation: 请保持联系。

sentences.text:
Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei
sentences.translation: 此致，张伟

essays.title: 2011年英语二·祝贺入学与准备建议

sentences.text: Dear Li Ming,
sentences.translation: 亲爱的李明：

sentences.text: Congratulations on being admitted to university!
sentences.translation: 祝贺你被大学录取！

sentences.text: I know how much effort you have put into this goal, and I am delighted that it has paid off.
sentences.translation: 我知道你为这个目标付出了很多努力，很高兴努力得到了回报。

sentences.text: Before the term begins, look through your course descriptions and make a flexible study plan.
sentences.translation: 开学前，浏览课程介绍，制定灵活的学习计划。

sentences.text: University learning calls for greater independence, so getting used to organizing your own time will help.
sentences.translation: 大学学习要求更强的独立性，因此习惯自行安排时间会有帮助。

sentences.text: I also suggest learning to manage a monthly budget and do basic household tasks.
sentences.translation: 我也建议你学习管理每月预算，承担基本家务。

sentences.text: These practical skills will leave you better prepared for living away from home.
sentences.translation: 这些实用技能会让你更好地为离家生活作准备。

sentences.text: Enjoy the summer, too.
sentences.translation: 也要享受暑假。

sentences.text: You have earned a break, and I wish you a wonderful new beginning.
sentences.translation: 你值得好好休息，祝你迎来美好的新开始。

sentences.text:
Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei
sentences.translation: 此致，张伟

essays.title: 2012年英语二·投诉电子词典

sentences.text: Dear Sir or Madam,
sentences.translation: 尊敬的先生或女士：

sentences.text: I am writing about an electronic dictionary purchased from your online store three days ago.
sentences.translation: 我就三天前从贵网店购买的电子词典来信。

sentences.text: Unfortunately, it has not worked properly since delivery.
sentences.translation: 很遗憾，词典自送达起就未正常工作。

sentences.text: The screen repeatedly goes blank, and several keys fail to respond, making the dictionary unusable for my studies.
sentences.translation: 屏幕反复变为空白，几个按键也没有反应，导致词典无法用于学习。

sentences.text: I would therefore appreciate a replacement at no additional cost.
sentences.translation: 因此，希望能免费更换新品。

sentences.text: If this cannot be arranged promptly, please issue a full refund and advise me how to return the faulty item.

essays.title: 2016年英语二·感谢祝贺与翻译建议

sentences.text: Dear Jack,
sentences.translation: 亲爱的Jack：

sentences.text: Thank you for your congratulations.
sentences.translation: 谢谢你的祝贺。

sentences.text: I am delighted that you share my interest in translation and would gladly offer a few suggestions.
sentences.translation: 很高兴你也对翻译感兴趣，我很愿意提供几条建议。

sentences.text: First, develop a good command of both languages through regular reading.
sentences.translation: 首先，通过经常阅读，熟练掌握两种语言。

sentences.text: A translation must sound natural as well as convey the original meaning.
sentences.translation: 译文既要自然，也要传达原意。

sentences.text: Before drafting, identify the writer’s main point and the links between sentences rather than translate word for word.
sentences.translation: 动笔前，先确定作者主旨与句间联系，不要逐词硬译。

sentences.text: Then compare your version with a reliable translation, paying attention to differences in phrasing.
sentences.translation: 随后将自己的译文与可靠译文比较，留意措辞差别。

sentences.text: Keep a record of useful expressions and recurring mistakes to make each exercise more rewarding.
sentences.translation: 记录有用表达和反复出现的错误，让每次练习更有收获。

sentences.text: I hope these suggestions help.
sentences.translation: 希望这些建议有帮助。

sentences.text: I would love to discuss your translations sometime.
sentences.translation: 我也很愿意找机会讨论你的译文。

sentences.text:
Best wishes,
Li Ming
sentences.translation: 祝好，李明

essays.title: 2017年英语二·接受中国文化演讲邀请

sentences.text: Dear Professor Williams,
sentences.translation: 尊敬的Williams教授：

sentences.text: Thank you for your invitation.
sentences.translation: 感谢您的邀请。

sentences.text: I would be delighted to speak to your international students about Chinese culture.
sentences.translation: 我很愿意向您的留学生介绍中国文化。

sentences.text: My presentation will focus on the Spring Festival and the meaning of family reunion.
sentences.translation: 演讲将聚焦春节及家庭团聚的意义。

sentences.text: I will begin with preparations such as cleaning homes and decorating doors, then explain how the reunion dinner brings generations together.
sentences.translation: 我会先介绍打扫房屋、装饰门面等准备，再解释团圆饭怎样让几代人相聚。

sentences.text: Photographs and a short story from my own family will help illustrate the meaning behind these customs.
sentences.translation: 照片和我家的一则小故事将帮助说明这些习俗背后的意义。

sentences.text: I would also like to invite students to compare them with celebrations in their own countries.
sentences.translation: 我也想邀请学生，将这些习俗与各自国家的节庆比较。

sentences.text: Please let me know the time available for the talk so that I can adjust the presentation accordingly.
sentences.translation: 请告知演讲可用时长，以便我相应调整内容。

sentences.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
sentences.translation: 此致，李明

sentences.text: Given the choice, I would recommend the robot show this Sunday.

sentences.text: It offers a chance to see technology in action rather than simply read about it.
sentences.translation: 它让你看到技术实际运用，而不只是读到有关介绍。

sentences.text: Watching machines perform practical tasks could make ideas about automation much easier to grasp.
sentences.translation: 观看机器执行实际任务，能让自动化概念更容易理解。

sentences.text: You could also ask questions about how the robots work and consider where human judgement is still needed.
sentences.translation: 你也可以询问机器人原理，思考哪些地方仍需要人的判断。

sentences.text: That combination of demonstration and discussion would make the visit both entertaining and thought-provoking.
sentences.translation: 演示与交流的结合，会让参观既有趣又引人思考。

sentences.text: While the art exhibition is certainly appealing, the robot show seems the better choice for an afternoon of discovery.
sentences.translation: 艺术展当然也有吸引力，但若想在一个下午探索新事物，机器人展似乎更合适。

sentences.text: I hope this helps you decide.
sentences.translation: 希望这能帮助你决定。

sentences.text: I would be interested to hear what you learn.
sentences.translation: 我很想听听你的收获。

sentences.text:
Best wishes,
Li Ming

sentences.text: Dear Jack,
sentences.translation: 亲爱的Jack：

sentences.text: For our survey on old-house protection, I suggest combining field observations with interviews so that we can understand both the buildings’ condition and residents’ concerns.
sentences.translation: 关于我们的老屋保护调查，我建议把实地观察与访谈结合，以同时了解建筑状况和居民关切。

sentences.text: We could first select several streets and keep a record of signs of damage or restoration, taking photographs with permission.
sentences.translation: 我们可以先选几条街，记录损坏或修复迹象，并经允许拍照。

sentences.text: Then we could conduct interviews with residents about maintenance costs, everyday needs and their views on preservation.
sentences.translation: 然后就维护成本、日常需要和保护观点采访居民。

sentences.text: A short conversation with local officials would help us learn about existing policies.
sentences.translation: 与当地工作人员简短交谈，有助于了解现有政策。

sentences.text: I can draft the observation checklist while you prepare interview questions; afterwards, we can compare our findings.
sentences.translation: 我拟观察清单，你准备访谈问题，随后我们共同比较发现。

sentences.text: Does this approach sound workable to you?
sentences.translation: 你觉得这个方法可行吗？

sentences.text: I would welcome any changes you suggest.
sentences.translation: 欢迎提出任何修改建议。

sentences.text:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
sentences.translation: 此致，李明

essays.title: 2010年英语二·手机用户量的不同增长

sentences.text: The chart reveals contrasting growth in mobile phone subscriptions between 2000 and 2008.
sentences.translation: 图表显示2000至2008年手机订阅量在两类国家的不同增长态势。

sentences.text: In developing countries, subscriptions showed a sharp increase from well below 1 billion to 4 billion, whereas developed countries recorded a much gentler rise to approximately 1 billion.
sentences.translation: 发展中国家的订阅量由远低于十亿大幅增至四十亿，发达国家则缓慢增至约十亿。

sentences.text: Particularly striking is the rapid expansion of the developing market from 2000 to 2008.
sentences.translation: 尤其显著的是2000至2008年发展中市场的迅速扩张。

sentences.text: This contrast is understandable.
sentences.translation: 这一对照不难理解。

sentences.text: One possible explanation is that cheaper handsets and wider network coverage made mobile services easier to access in developing countries.
sentences.translation: 一种可能的解释是，更便宜的手机与更广的网络覆盖，让发展中国家的移动服务更易获取。

sentences.text: Mobile phones also offer practical value: people can contact distant relatives, obtain information and conduct business without travelling.
sentences.translation: 手机也有实用价值：人们不用出行便可联系远方亲人、获取信息、开展业务。

sentences.text: In developed countries, where subscriptions are already widespread, there is naturally less scope for similarly dramatic growth.
sentences.translation: 在手机订阅已普及的发达国家，出现同样大幅增长的空间自然较小。

sentences.text: The expansion therefore represents more than a larger consumer market; it can mean wider access to opportunities.
sentences.translation: 因此，扩张不只意味着消费市场变大，也可能意味着更多人获得机会。

sentences.text: The next challenge is to make connections affordable and dependable, particularly in remote communities.
sentences.translation: 接下来的挑战是让连接价格可负担、服务可靠，尤其在偏远社区。

sentences.text: When access is matched by useful services, mobile communication can become an everyday resource for learning, work and social contact.
sentences.translation: 当可达性与有用服务配合，移动通信就能成为学习、工作和社会交往的日常资源。

essays.title: 2011年英语二·汽车品牌市场份额变化

sentences.text: The chart shows a reversal in ranking between Chinese and Japanese car brands from 2008 to 2009.
sentences.translation: 图表显示2008至2009年国产与日系汽车品牌排名逆转。

sentences.text: Chinese brands expanded their market share from about a quarter to nearly a third, overtaking Japanese brands, whose share fell from roughly 35% to 25%.
sentences.translation: 国产品牌份额由约四分之一升至接近三分之一，超过日系；日系份额则由约35%降至25%。

sentences.text: American brands remained relatively stable at around 12% to 13%.
sentences.translation: 美系品牌相对稳定，约为12%至13%。

sentences.text: The shift suggests that market leadership is not permanent.
sentences.translation: 这一变化表明，市场领先地位并非永久。

sentences.text: Competitive pricing and improvements in design and quality may have made Chinese cars a more attractive choice.
sentences.translation: 有竞争力的定价，以及设计、质量改善，可能让国产汽车更具吸引力。

sentences.text: A better understanding of local buyers’ preferences can also help manufacturers offer the features customers actually need.
sentences.translation: 更好理解本地买家偏好，也能帮助厂商提供顾客真正需要的功能。

sentences.text: When alternatives become more appealing, established brands must work harder to justify their prices and preserve customer loyalty.
sentences.translation: 当替代选项更有吸引力，老牌厂商必须更努力证明价格合理、维持顾客忠诚。

sentences.text: For manufacturers, the lesson is to earn rather than assume consumers’ trust.
sentences.translation: 对厂商而言，启示是要赢得、而非想当然地拥有消费者信任。

sentences.text: Winning market share creates an opportunity, but reliable performance and effective after-sales service are what encourage customers to return.
sentences.translation: 赢得市场份额带来机会，但可靠性能与有效售后才会促使顾客再次选择。

sentences.text: Chinese brands should therefore treat their advance as a reason to keep improving, not as a guarantee of lasting success.
sentences.translation: 因此，国产品牌应把进展当作继续改善的理由，而非长久成功的保证。

essays.title: 2012年英语二·不同年龄员工的工作满意度

sentences.text: The table reveals a pronounced age difference in job satisfaction at a company.
sentences.translation: 表格显示某公司工作满意度存在明显年龄差异。

sentences.text: Among employees aged 41 to 50, 64% are dissatisfied and none are satisfied.
sentences.translation: 41至50岁员工中，64%不满意，无人表示满意。

sentences.text: By contrast, satisfaction reaches 40% among those over 50, whose dissatisfaction rate is just 10%.
sentences.translation: 相比之下，50岁以上员工满意率为40%，不满意率仅10%。

sentences.text: Employees aged 40 or below fall between these extremes, with 16.7% satisfied and 33.3% dissatisfied.
sentences.translation: 40岁及以下员工处于两端之间，16.7%满意、33.3%不满意。

sentences.text: The middle group’s discontent deserves particular attention.
sentences.translation: 中间组的不满尤其值得注意。

sentences.text: At this career stage, expectations of promotion may collide with limited opportunities, while family responsibilities make financial security especially important.
sentences.translation: 在此职业阶段，晋升期待可能遭遇机会有限的现实，而家庭责任使经济保障尤为重要。

sentences.text: Older employees may have more settled positions and expectations.
sentences.translation: 较年长员工可能已有更稳定的岗位与期待。

sentences.text: These differences suggest that the same workplace can be experienced quite differently according to employees’ circumstances.
sentences.translation: 这些差异表明，同一工作场所会因员工处境不同而被不同地体验。

sentences.text: Management should therefore look beyond an overall satisfaction figure.
sentences.translation: 因此，管理者应超越总体满意度数字。

sentences.text: Confidential feedback could identify the pressures facing each group, allowing the company to offer clearer promotion paths, appropriate training and practical support.
sentences.translation: 保密反馈可发现各组压力，让公司提供更清楚的晋升路径、合适培训与实际支持。

sentences.text: Addressing specific concerns is more likely to improve morale than providing benefits that overlook what employees actually need.
sentences.translation: 回应具体关切，比提供忽视真实需要的福利更有可能提升士气。

sentences.text: The chart compares part-time employment across four year groups at a university.
sentences.translation: 图表比较某高校四个年级的兼职情况。

sentences.text: The proportion is 67.77% among first-year students and just over 71% among both second-year and third-year students.
sentences.translation: 大一比例为67.77%，大二、大三均略高于71%。

sentences.text: It reaches 88.24% in the final year, making graduating students the most active participants by a considerable margin.
sentences.translation: 大四达到88.24%，毕业年级以明显差距成为参与最积极的群体。

sentences.text: The contrast is closely connected with the transition from university to employment.
sentences.translation: 这一对照与从大学到就业的过渡密切相关。

sentences.text: As graduation approaches, practical experience becomes more valuable: students need to test career interests, develop transferable skills and demonstrate their abilities to employers.
sentences.translation: 随着毕业临近，实践经验更有价值：学生需要探索职业兴趣、发展可迁移技能，并向雇主展示能力。

sentences.text: Part-time work can provide these opportunities while helping with living expenses.
sentences.translation: 兼职可以提供这些机会，同时帮助承担生活费用。

sentences.text: The particularly high final-year figure thus reflects how strongly employment concerns may shape students’ choices.
sentences.translation: 因此，毕业年级的高比例反映就业关切可能强烈影响学生选择。

sentences.text: Such work is most beneficial when it complements rather than displaces education.
sentences.translation: 这类工作在补充而非挤占教育时最有益。

sentences.text: Universities should help students find trustworthy employers and positions with genuine learning value.
sentences.translation: 高校应帮助学生寻找可信雇主和确有学习价值的岗位。

sentences.text: Students, in turn, should consider what a job teaches them as well as what it pays.
sentences.translation: 学生也应既考虑工作教会自己什么，也考虑报酬。

sentences.text: A carefully chosen position can help students prepare for employment.
sentences.translation: 精心选择的岗位可帮助学生为就业作准备。

essays.title: 2014年英语二·城乡人口变化

sentences.text: The chart illustrates a major redistribution of China’s population between 1990 and 2010.
sentences.translation: 图表显示1990至2010年中国人口大幅重新分布。

sentences.text: The urban population more than doubled, rising from 300 million to 666 million, while the rural population declined from 834 million to 674 million.
sentences.translation: 城镇人口由三亿增至六亿六千六百万，达到两倍以上；乡村人口则由八亿三千四百万降至六亿七千四百万。

sentences.text: By 2010, the two population figures were almost equal.
sentences.translation: 到2010年，两组人口数值几乎相等。

sentences.text: This movement is closely associated with urbanization.
sentences.translation: 这一流动与城镇化密切相关。

sentences.text: Expanding industries and services create jobs that attract rural workers, while access to education, healthcare and other facilities can make city life appealing to their families.
sentences.translation: 扩大的工业和服务业创造岗位吸引农村劳动者，教育、医疗等设施的可达性也让城市生活对其家人有吸引力。

sentences.text: As more people settle in cities, growing demand can put pressure on housing and public services, further reshaping everyday life.
sentences.translation: 随着更多人在城市定居，增加的需求可能给住房与公共服务带来压力，进一步重塑日常生活。

sentences.text: The central task is therefore to make urban growth improve people’s lives.
sentences.translation: 因此，核心任务是让城市增长改善人们生活。

sentences.text: Affordable housing, accessible schools and dependable transport must develop alongside population increases.
sentences.translation: 可负担住房、可及学校与可靠交通必须随人口同步发展。

sentences.text: Rural areas also need investment so that migration remains a choice rather than a necessity.
sentences.translation: 农村也需要投入，使迁移是一种选择，而非迫不得已。

sentences.text: Successful urbanization should be measured not simply by how many people live in cities, but by the opportunities available to residents in both settings.
sentences.translation: 成功城镇化不只看多少人住在城市，还看城乡居民能够获得怎样的机会。

essays.title: 2015年英语二·春节花销构成

sentences.text: The pie chart presents Spring Festival spending in a Chinese city.
sentences.translation: 饼图展示中国某市居民春节花销。

sentences.text: Gifts take the largest share, at 40%, while transport, meals with family and friends, and other expenses each account for 20%.
sentences.translation: 礼物占最大份额40%，交通、亲友聚餐及其他支出各20%。

sentences.text: Together, transport and meals account for 40% of spending.
sentences.translation: 交通与聚餐合计占支出的40%。

sentences.text: The pattern reflects the festival’s role in sustaining personal relationships.
sentences.translation: 该分布反映春节维系人际关系的作用。

sentences.text: Presents convey affection and good wishes, travel enables reunions, and shared meals give relatives time to reconnect.
sentences.translation: 礼物传达关爱与祝愿，出行促成团聚，共餐给亲人重新交流的时间。

sentences.text: Much of this expenditure buys not merely goods or services but occasions for expressing care.
sentences.translation: 相当一部分花销购买的不只是商品或服务，也是在乎彼此的表达机会。

sentences.text: Nevertheless, the prominence of gifts also raises a question: does their price always reflect their meaning?
sentences.translation: 然而，礼物的重要份额也提出问题：价格总能反映意义吗？

sentences.text: In my view, festive spending is worthwhile when it strengthens relationships without creating financial strain.
sentences.translation: 我认为，节日花销在增进关系又不制造经济负担时值得。

sentences.text: A thoughtful, affordable present can communicate more than an expensive purchase made out of obligation.
sentences.translation: 用心、价格可负担的礼物，可能比出于人情义务购买的昂贵商品更能传达心意。

sentences.text: By budgeting sensibly and giving time as generously as money, people can preserve the warmth of the celebration while avoiding unnecessary competition over spending.
sentences.translation: 合理预算，并像慷慨花钱一样慷慨付出时间，人们就能保留节日温暖，避免不必要的消费攀比。

essays.title: 2016年英语二·大学生旅游目的

sentences.text: The pie chart shows why students at a university travel.
sentences.translation: 饼图显示某高校学生为何旅游。

sentences.text: Enjoying scenery and relieving stress dominate, accounting for 37% and 33% respectively.
sentences.translation: 欣赏风景和缓解压力占主导，分别为37%与33%。

sentences.text: Making friends represents 9%, developing independence 6%, and other purposes the remaining 15%.
sentences.translation: 交友占9%，培养独立能力占6%，其他目的占剩余15%。

sentences.text: Together, sightseeing and relaxation account for seven out of every ten responses.
sentences.translation: 观景与放松合计占每十份回答中的七份。

sentences.text: These priorities are understandable in the context of university life.
sentences.translation: 结合大学生活，这些优先事项可以理解。

sentences.text: Academic deadlines and uncertainty about the future can make students eager for a change of scene.
sentences.translation: 学业期限与未来不确定性，会让学生渴望换个环境。

sentences.text: Travel offers a temporary escape from familiar pressures, while natural surroundings provide pleasure that everyday routines may lack.
sentences.translation: 旅游让学生暂离熟悉压力，自然环境也提供日常作息可能缺少的乐趣。

sentences.text: The two leading purposes therefore reinforce each other: enjoying a different environment can itself be a way of recovering energy.
sentences.translation: 两项主要目的相互促进：享受不同环境，本身就是恢复精力的方式。

sentences.text: Travel need not be justified solely by measurable achievements.
sentences.translation: 旅游不必只靠可衡量的成就证明价值。

sentences.text: Rest and enjoyment have value, provided that a trip suits a student’s time and budget.
sentences.translation: 只要行程符合学生时间与预算，休息和享受本就有价值。

sentences.text: By planning sensibly and engaging with the places they visit, students can return refreshed, with a broader perspective as well as pleasant memories.
sentences.translation: 合理规划、主动接触目的地，能让学生精神焕发地回来，既有美好回忆，也有更宽广视角。

source.promptSummary: 欣赏风景37%，缓解压力33%，广交朋友9%，培养独立能力6%，其他15%。

essays.title: 2017年英语二·博物馆数量与参观人次

sentences.text: The chart records growth in both museum provision and attendance in China from 2013 to 2015.
sentences.translation: 图表记录2013至2015年中国博物馆供给与参观人次共同增长。

sentences.text: Museum numbers rose from about 4,200 to 4,700, while annual visits increased from approximately 640 million to 780 million.
sentences.translation: 博物馆约由4200家升至4700家，年参观人次由约6.4亿增至7.8亿。

sentences.text: Attendance grew faster proportionally, indicating more visits per museum on average.
sentences.translation: 人次相对增长更快，表明平均每馆人次增加。

sentences.text: The two trends can reinforce each other.
sentences.translation: 两种趋势可以相互促进。

sentences.text: More museums bring cultural resources within reach of a wider public, while engaging exhibitions give people reasons to visit.
sentences.translation: 更多博物馆让更广泛公众接触文化资源，吸引人的展览则给人们参观理由。

sentences.text: Schools and families can also use museums to make history and culture tangible.
sentences.translation: 学校与家庭也可用博物馆，使历史文化具体可感。

sentences.text: As interest grows, demand encourages institutions to improve their collections, explanations and services, making museums more valuable places for learning.
sentences.translation: 兴趣上升时，需求促使机构改善藏品、解释与服务，让博物馆更有学习价值。

sentences.text: Continued progress should therefore concern the quality of encounters, not visitor totals alone.
sentences.translation: 因此，持续进步应关注体验质量，而不只看参观总量。

sentences.text: Clear labels, knowledgeable guides and activities for different ages can turn a brief visit into lasting curiosity.
sentences.translation: 清楚展签、知识丰富的讲解员与适合不同年龄的活动，可让短暂参观激发持久好奇。

sentences.text: By helping visitors understand what they see, museums can ensure that wider access leads to deeper cultural engagement rather than simply larger crowds.
sentences.translation: 帮助来访者理解所见，能确保更广接触通向更深文化参与，而不只是更大人流。

essays.title: 2018年英语二·选择餐厅的关注因素

sentences.text: The pie chart shows what consumers consider when choosing restaurants in a city.
sentences.translation: 饼图显示某市消费者选择餐厅时考虑什么。

sentences.text: Distinctive features rank first at 36.3%, followed by service at 26.8% and the dining environment at 23.8%.
sentences.translation: 特色以36.3%居首，其次为服务26.8%与用餐环境23.8%。

sentences.text: Price accounts for less than a tenth, at 8.4%, while other factors represent 4.7%.
sentences.translation: 价格占不到十分之一，为8.4%，其他因素为4.7%。

sentences.text: Experience clearly carries considerable weight in these choices.
sentences.translation: 体验在这些选择中显然很有分量。

sentences.text: Dining out serves purposes beyond satisfying hunger.
sentences.translation: 外出用餐的目的不只在填饱肚子。

sentences.text: A distinctive menu can make a meal memorable, attentive service makes guests feel valued, and a comfortable setting allows conversation to flow.
sentences.translation: 特色菜单让一餐难忘，周到服务让顾客感到被重视，舒适环境则让交谈顺畅。

sentences.text: These benefits matter particularly when people eat together to celebrate or maintain relationships.
sentences.translation: 人们为庆祝或维系关系而共餐时，这些收益尤其重要。

sentences.text: A lower price may offer savings, but it cannot by itself provide the experience customers seek.
sentences.translation: 更低价格可能节省开支，却不能独自提供顾客追求的体验。

sentences.text: Restaurant owners should therefore build a recognizable identity without neglecting everyday standards.
sentences.translation: 因此，经营者应建立鲜明定位，同时不忽略日常标准。

sentences.text: Creative dishes will attract attention only briefly if food quality or service disappoints.
sentences.translation: 如果出品或服务令人失望，创意菜只能短暂吸引注意。

sentences.text: Combining distinctive strengths with dependable performance is more likely to earn repeat visits than relying on novelty alone.
sentences.translation: 把鲜明特色与可靠表现结合起来，比仅依赖新奇感更可能赢得再次光顾。

sentences.text: The aim should be to give customers a reason to return, rather than merely a reason to enter.
sentences.translation: 目标应是给顾客再来的理由，而不只是进店一次的理由。

essays.title: 2019年英语二·本科毕业生去向变化

sentences.text: The chart compares graduate destinations at a university in 2013 and 2018.
sentences.translation: 图表比较某高校2013与2018年的毕业去向。

sentences.text: Employment remained the largest category, although its share fell from 68.1% to 60.7%.
sentences.translation: 就业仍是最大类别，尽管份额由68.1%降至60.7%。

sentences.text: Further study rose from 26.3% to 34%, while entrepreneurship doubled from a low base of 1.3% to 2.6%, though it still represented a limited share.
sentences.translation: 升学由26.3%增至34%，创业则由1.3%的低基数翻倍至2.6%，但仍只占有限份额。

sentences.text: The shift towards further study may reflect a desire for stronger qualifications and more specialized knowledge.
sentences.translation: 转向升学可能反映对更强资历与更专门知识的追求。

sentences.text: Faced with demanding recruitment standards, graduates may regard additional education as an investment in future opportunities.
sentences.translation: 面对较高招聘标准，毕业生可能把额外教育视为对未来机会的投资。

sentences.text: Others may prefer to test a business idea, accepting uncertainty in exchange for greater independence.
sentences.translation: 另一些人可能更愿尝试商业想法，以接受不确定性换取更大独立性。

sentences.text: Together, these changes suggest that the transition from university to work is becoming less uniform.
sentences.translation: 这些变化共同说明，从大学到工作的过渡正在变得更多样。

sentences.text: Universities should respond with guidance that recognizes different ambitions.
sentences.translation: 高校应提供承认不同志向的指导。

sentences.text: Students need realistic information about employment, postgraduate study and business risks, alongside opportunities to assess their own strengths.
sentences.translation: 学生需要关于就业、研究生学习和创业风险的现实信息，也需要评估个人优势的机会。

sentences.text: No route is automatically superior: further study is valuable when it serves a clear purpose, just as a job is valuable when it offers suitable prospects for development.
sentences.translation: 没有哪条路天然更好：深造因服务明确目的而有价值，工作则因提供适合的发展前景而有价值。

source.referenceFile: 09 历年大作文范文与解析.md

essays.title: 2020年英语二·手机阅读目的

sentences.text: The pie chart presents the purposes of mobile reading among students at a university.
sentences.translation: 饼图展示某高校学生手机阅读的目的。

sentences.text: Learning accounts for 59.5%, well ahead of passing the time at 21.3% and obtaining information at 17%.
sentences.translation: 学习占59.5%，明显高于消磨时间21.3%与获取信息17%。

sentences.text: Other purposes make up 2.2%.
sentences.translation: 其他目的占2.2%。

sentences.text: The dominant share of learning highlights the phone’s potential as a study tool.
sentences.translation: 学习的主导份额凸显手机作为学习工具的潜力。

sentences.text: Its appeal lies partly in removing barriers of time and place.
sentences.translation: 它的吸引力部分在于突破时间与地点限制。

sentences.text: A student can consult an article between classes or carry an entire library without carrying a bag of books.
sentences.translation: 学生可在课间查阅文章，也可不背一袋书就随身携带一整个图书馆。

sentences.text: Understanding, however, does not arise merely because a text is accessible; it requires sustained attention.
sentences.translation: 然而，理解不会仅因文本容易获取而自然产生；它需要持续专注。

sentences.text: The same device that opens a useful text also delivers messages and distractions, making concentration an essential part of effective mobile learning.
sentences.translation: 打开有用文本的同一设备，也带来消息与干扰，使专注成为有效手机学习的必要部分。

sentences.text: The challenge is therefore to turn convenience into sustained attention.
sentences.translation: 因此，挑战是把便利转为持续注意。

sentences.text: Students can select reliable materials, silence unnecessary notifications and reserve time for reading beyond brief fragments.
sentences.translation: 学生可选可靠材料、关闭不必要通知，并为超越零碎片段的阅读预留时间。

sentences.text: Mobile reading is most productive when accessibility serves a clear purpose: not simply to consume more words, but to understand, question and retain what is read.
sentences.translation: 便捷获取服务清楚目的时，手机阅读最有效：不只摄入更多文字，而是理解、质疑并记住所读。
