essays.title: 2021年英语二·体育锻炼方式

sentences.text: The chart shows how residents of a city exercise.
sentences.translation: 图表显示某市居民怎样锻炼。

sentences.text: Just over half (54.3%) report exercising alone, followed by 47.7% who exercise with friends.
sentences.translation: 略超一半即54.3%报告独自锻炼，其次为47.7%与朋友锻炼。

sentences.text: Family exercise attracts 23.9%, while organized group activities account for 15.8%.
sentences.translation: 家庭锻炼为23.9%，有组织团体活动为15.8%。

sentences.text: Individual exercise and informal companionship are therefore more common than organized participation.
sentences.translation: 因此，个人锻炼与非正式陪伴，比有组织参与更普遍。

sentences.text: Convenience helps explain the pattern.
sentences.translation: 便利有助于解释这种分布。

sentences.text: Exercising alone allows people to choose their own schedule and pace, avoiding the difficulty of coordinating busy lives.
sentences.translation: 独自锻炼让人选择自己的时间和节奏，避免协调繁忙生活的困难。

sentences.text: Friends, meanwhile, can provide encouragement without requiring the structure of a formal programme.
sentences.translation: 朋友则能提供鼓励，不必依赖正式项目的组织。

sentences.text: Their company may turn exercise from a duty into an enjoyable social occasion.
sentences.translation: 陪伴可以把锻炼从一项义务变成愉快社交。

sentences.text: Organized activities can be useful, but fixed times and locations may make them harder to fit into daily routines.
sentences.translation: 有组织活动可能有用，但固定时间地点更难融入日常作息。

sentences.text: The practical lesson is to make regular exercise easy to sustain.
sentences.translation: 实际启示是让规律锻炼更容易保持。

sentences.text: Communities should provide accessible spaces for individuals as well as flexible opportunities for people to exercise together.
sentences.translation: 社区既应提供适合个人的可及空间，也应给结伴锻炼提供灵活机会。

sentences.text: Residents can then choose arrangements that suit their circumstances.
sentences.translation: 居民便可选择适合处境的安排。

sentences.text: A routine that people enjoy and maintain matters more than whether they follow it alone or in company.
sentences.translation: 让人喜欢且能坚持的习惯，比独自还是结伴实行更重要。

essays.title: 2022年英语二·全国与农村快递业务量

sentences.text: The chart shows substantial growth in China’s express delivery volume between 2018 and 2020.
sentences.translation: 图表显示2018至2020年中国快递业务量显著增长。

sentences.text: National deliveries rose from 51 billion to 83 billion parcels, while rural deliveries increased from 12 billion to 30 billion.
sentences.translation: 全国由510亿件增至830亿件，农村由120亿件增至300亿件。

sentences.text: Particularly striking is the doubling of rural volume from 2019 to 2020.
sentences.translation: 尤其突出的是农村业务量在2019至2020年翻倍。

sentences.text: This expansion reflects the close relationship between online commerce and physical distribution.
sentences.translation: 这种扩张反映线上商业与实体配送的紧密关系。

sentences.text: Ordering goods is convenient only when they can reach buyers reliably.
sentences.translation: 只有商品能可靠到达买家，订购才真正便利。

sentences.text: Improved roads, local collection points and delivery networks can bring rural households into larger markets.
sentences.translation: 道路、当地取件点及配送网络的改善，能让农村家庭进入更广市场。

sentences.text: The benefits also run in the opposite direction: rural producers can sell beyond their immediate surroundings, creating further demand for delivery services.
sentences.translation: 收益也向相反方向延伸：农村生产者能销往周边之外，进一步创造配送需求。

sentences.text: The figures thus point to stronger connections between rural and urban economies.
sentences.translation: 因此，数据反映城乡经济联系增强。

sentences.text: To sustain these benefits, the sector should improve efficiency while reducing damaged parcels, excessive packaging and pressure on delivery workers.
sentences.translation: 为维持收益，行业应在提升效率的同时，减少包裹损坏、过度包装与快递员压力。

sentences.text: Growth is most meaningful when it makes trade more accessible without shifting unreasonable costs onto people or the environment.
sentences.translation: 增长在便利交易，又不把不合理成本转嫁给人或环境时最有意义。

sentences.text: Better connections should bring better service, not volume alone.
sentences.translation: 更好连接应带来更好服务，而不只是更多业务量。

essays.title: 2023年英语二·居民健康素养水平变化

sentences.text: The line chart records a sustained improvement in health literacy among Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021.
sentences.translation: 折线图记录2012至2021年中国居民健康素养持续改善。

sentences.text: The proportion rose from 8.80% to 25.40%, with growth becoming more pronounced in later years.
sentences.translation: 比例由8.80%升至25.40%，后期增长更明显。

sentences.text: This rise points to a growing capacity to obtain, understand and use basic health information in everyday decisions.
sentences.translation: 这反映获取、理解并在日常决策中运用基本健康信息的能力增强。

sentences.text: Greater access to health education may help explain this progress.
sentences.translation: 健康教育更易获取，可能有助于解释这一进步。

sentences.text: Community guidance, clearer medical explanations and widely available information can bring practical knowledge into everyday life.
sentences.translation: 社区指导、更清楚的医疗解释，以及广泛可得信息，可把实用知识带入日常生活。

sentences.text: Yet knowledge becomes useful only when people can judge its reliability and apply it.
sentences.translation: 但只有能判断可靠性并运用时，知识才真正有用。

sentences.text: Understanding why a habit matters, for example, is more likely to support informed choices than merely remembering a slogan.
sentences.translation: 例如，理解一个习惯为何重要，比只记住一句口号更能支持有依据的选择。

sentences.text: Despite a gain of 16.6 percentage points, the 2021 figure still leaves considerable room for progress.
sentences.translation: 尽管已增加16.6个百分点，2021年的比例仍留下相当提升空间。

sentences.text: Public education can help by using plain language, presenting familiar situations and helping people distinguish sound advice from misleading claims.
sentences.translation: 公共教育可以通过使用通俗语言、呈现熟悉情境，并帮助人们区分可靠建议与误导性说法发挥作用。

sentences.text: The ultimate goal is not simply more information, but the ability to make sensible decisions when health questions arise in daily life.
sentences.translation: 最终目标不只是信息更多，而是在日常遇到健康问题时能够作出明智决定。

essays.title: 2024年英语二·劳动实践课收获

sentences.text: The chart summarizes students’ gains from a university course combining learning with practical work.
sentences.translation: 图表总结一门结合知识学习与实际操作的大学课程给学生带来的收获。

sentences.text: Acquiring knowledge leads at 91.3%, closely followed by improved practical skills at 84.8%.
sentences.translation: 获取知识以91.3%领先，动手技能提升84.8%紧随其后。

sentences.text: A better mood is reported by 54.4%, whereas improved teamwork skills are mentioned by 32.6%.
sentences.translation: 54.4%报告心情更好，32.6%提及团队合作技能提升。

sentences.text: The strongest benefits concern learning through direct participation.
sentences.translation: 最突出的收益是通过亲身参与学习。

sentences.text: Practical work makes ideas testable.
sentences.translation: 实践让想法变得可以检验。

sentences.text: When students plant, repair or produce something, practical work can help them connect instructions with actions and respond to results.
sentences.translation: 学生种植、修理或制作东西时，实践工作能帮助他们把指令与行动联系起来，并根据结果作出回应。

sentences.text: Completing a useful task can also bring satisfaction that passive learning rarely offers.
sentences.translation: 完成有用任务也能带来被动学习少有的满足。

sentences.text: Cooperation, however, does not arise merely because students work in the same place; it requires shared goals and meaningful dependence on one another.
sentences.translation: 但合作不会仅因学生在同一地点工作就产生，它需要共同目标与真实的相互依赖。

sentences.text: Course design should therefore preserve practical engagement while strengthening opportunities for teamwork.
sentences.translation: 因此，课程应保持实践投入，同时增加团队合作机会。

sentences.text: Projects can assign complementary responsibilities and ask students to reflect on both their results and their collaboration.
sentences.translation: 项目可分配互补职责，并要求学生反思结果与协作。

sentences.text: In this way, labour education can develop not only the ability to complete a task, but also the judgement and cooperation needed to complete it well with others.
sentences.translation: 如此，劳动教育不仅培养完成任务的能力，还培养与他人一起把任务做好的判断力与合作能力。

essays.title: 2025年英语二·老年人日常休闲活动

sentences.text: The chart shows elderly residents’ daily leisure activities in a community.
sentences.translation: 图表显示某社区老年居民日常休闲活动。

sentences.text: Television is most common at 90.8%, followed by walking at 68.3%.
sentences.translation: 看电视最普遍，为90.8%，其次为散步68.3%。

sentences.text: Gardening, reading and chess attract 34.7%, 31.8% and 18.4% respectively.
Easily accessible activities clearly occupy a prominent place in residents’ routines.
sentences.translation: 易参与的活动显然在居民作息中占重要位置。

sentences.text: Television offers information and entertainment with little physical effort, while walks provide gentle exercise and opportunities to meet neighbours.
sentences.translation: 看电视无需太多体力便能获得信息和娱乐，散步则提供温和运动及与邻居见面的机会。

sentences.text: Other activities may depend more on personal interests, space or companions.
sentences.translation: 其他活动可能更取决于个人兴趣、空间或伙伴。

sentences.text: Their lower participation rates need not reduce their value: reading can stimulate thought, and a game of chess can provide both mental challenge and social contact.
sentences.translation: 参与率较低不应降低它们的价值：阅读激发思考，下棋兼具智力挑战与社会交往。

sentences.text: The pattern therefore calls for variety rather than a single prescription for retirement.
sentences.translation: 因此，该分布需要的是多样选择，而非退休生活的统一处方。

sentences.text: Communities can help by maintaining safe paths, providing comfortable reading spaces and making it easy to find activity partners.
sentences.translation: 社区可维护安全步道、提供舒适阅读空间，并让寻找活动伙伴更容易。

sentences.text: These modest arrangements expand choice without imposing a preferred lifestyle.
sentences.translation: 这些不大的安排能扩大选择，而不强加一种被偏好的生活方式。

sentences.text: A satisfying later life depends not on everyone doing the same things, but on having meaningful activities suited to individual interests and abilities.
sentences.translation: 令人满意的晚年不在于人人做同样事情，而在于拥有适合各自兴趣与能力的有意义活动。

essays.title: 2026年英语二·儿童户外活动的看法

sentences.text: The chart presents views on children’s outdoor activities.
sentences.translation: 图表展示对儿童户外活动的看法。

sentences.text: Satisfying curiosity and developing observation skills receive almost identical support, at 54.6% and 54.5%.
sentences.translation: 满足好奇心与促进观察力得到几乎相同的支持，分别为54.6%与54.5%。

sentences.text: Physical fitness is mentioned by 37.2%, while stronger parent-child interaction attracts 33.2%.
sentences.translation: 37.2%提及强身健体，33.2%提及增强亲子互动。

sentences.text: The strongest benefits concern intellectual exploration.
sentences.translation: 最突出的收益涉及智力探索。

sentences.text: Outdoors, children encounter things that cannot be fully understood from descriptions alone.
sentences.translation: 户外让孩子遇到仅靠描述无法充分理解的事物。

sentences.text: Watching an insect or noticing seasonal changes invites questions, close attention and the testing of ideas.
sentences.translation: 观看昆虫、留意季节变化，会引发提问、细看与检验想法。

sentences.text: Movement adds physical benefits, while a parent’s participation can turn discovery into conversation.
sentences.translation: 活动身体增加体能收益，父母参与也可把发现转化为交谈。

sentences.text: These gains are connected: a shared walk can exercise the body, stimulate curiosity and create time for family contact.
sentences.translation: 这些收益彼此关联：共同散步可锻炼身体、激发好奇，并创造家人交流时间。

sentences.text: Adults should therefore leave room for exploration rather than organize every moment around instructions.
sentences.translation: 因此，成人应给探索留空间，而非把每一刻都安排成服从指令。

sentences.text: Choosing safe surroundings, listening to questions and allowing time to observe can make ordinary outings valuable.
sentences.translation: 选择安全环境、倾听问题、给足观察时间，可以让普通外出有价值。

sentences.text: The aim is not to turn nature into another classroom, but to let children learn through active engagement with the world and the people beside them.
sentences.translation: 目标不是把自然变成另一个课堂，而是让孩子通过主动接触世界和身边的人来学习。

essays.title: 翻译练习方法建议

sentences.text: Dear Jack,
sentences.translation: 亲爱的Jack：

sentences.text: To make steady progress, set realistic goals and build a manageable routine rather than translate long passages occasionally.
sentences.translation: 要稳步进步，应设定现实目标、建立可坚持的安排，而非偶尔翻译长文。

sentences.text: Break a difficult task into steps: understand the passage, draft your translation and compare versions of the same passage.
sentences.translation: 把困难任务拆成几步：理解文章、起草译文、比较不同版本。

sentences.text: Regular reading will also help you build a foundation for natural expression.
sentences.translation: 经常阅读也有助于为自然表达打下基础。

sentences.text: Seek meaningful feedback to identify your weaknesses, then put what you learn into practice in the next exercise.
sentences.translation: 寻求有实际帮助的反馈来发现薄弱处，再把所学用于下一次练习。

sentences.text: Pay attention to recurring mistakes instead of trying to correct everything at once.
sentences.translation: 注意反复出现的错误，不必一次纠正所有问题。

sentences.text: A short notebook will make it easier to compare your work over time.
sentences.translation: 一个简短记录本将让你更容易比较不同时期的作品。

sentences.text: I hope this approach helps you make each session more useful.
sentences.translation: 希望这个方法让每次练习更有价值。

sentences.text: Best wishes, Li Ming
sentences.translation: 祝好，李明

sentences.text: Dear Jack,
sentences.translation: 亲爱的Jack：

sentences.text: I would like to put forward a plan for our investigation of existing protection measures.
sentences.translation: 我想就现有保护措施的调查提出计划。

sentences.text: For our investigation, I suggest making field observations and conducting interviews so that we can collect reliable evidence and identify common concerns.
sentences.translation: 对于这次调查，我建议开展实地观察与访谈，以便收集可靠依据并找出共同关切。

sentences.text: Let us share responsibilities: I will prepare a draft of the checklist while you design questions about costs and local traditions.
sentences.translation: 我们分担职责：我起草记录清单，你设计关于成本和地方传统的问题。

sentences.text: We can then make revisions together and reach an agreement before the visit.
sentences.translation: 之后我们共同修改，在走访前达成一致。

sentences.text: A shared schedule will help us keep track of the work.
sentences.translation: 统一日程将帮助我们跟踪工作。

sentences.text: With permission, photographs can help us check details when we compare our findings.
sentences.translation: 经允许拍摄的照片，可在比较调查发现时帮助核对细节。

essays.title: 社区健身项目参与变化

sentences.text: The chart shows an upward trend in participation in a community exercise programme from 2017 to 2023.
sentences.translation: 图表显示2017至2023年社区健身项目参与率上升。

sentences.text: Starting at 10%, the rate reached a peak of 60%, with a sharp increase between 2019 and 2020.
sentences.translation: 参与率由10%升至60%，2019至2020年间大幅增加。

sentences.text: Growth accelerated initially, then slowed before the rate began to level off in 2022.
sentences.translation: 增长起初加快，随后放缓，到2022年参与率开始趋稳。

sentences.text: One possible explanation is that more accessible sessions made regular physical activity easier to fit into daily routines.
sentences.translation: 一个可能解释是更易参与的课程让规律身体活动更容易融入日常作息。

sentences.text: Flexible sessions allow participants to choose their own pace, while exercising with neighbours offers mutual encouragement.
sentences.translation: 灵活课程让参与者自行选择节奏，与邻居锻炼则提供相互鼓励。

sentences.text: Under these conditions, people may find it easier to maintain a habit instead of attending only occasionally.
sentences.translation: 在这些条件下，人们可能更容易保持习惯，而非偶尔参加。

sentences.text: A stable participation rate does not mean that the programme has no further value.
sentences.translation: 参与率稳定不代表项目已无更多价值。

sentences.text: Organizers should seek feedback from residents who remain excluded and offer suitable times and activities.
sentences.translation: 组织者应向仍无法参加的居民征求反馈，提供合适时段与活动。

sentences.text: Serving existing participants well remains important even when attracting new members becomes more difficult.
sentences.translation: 即使吸引新成员变得更困难，服务好现有参与者依然重要。

sentences.text: Even when growth slows, maintaining enjoyable, reliable opportunities can protect the long-term benefits of participation.
sentences.translation: 即使增长放缓，保持愉快、可靠的参与机会仍可维护长期收益。

source.prompt: Write an essay describing the chart of participation in a community exercise programme, explain possible reasons and give comments. Write about 150 words.

essays.title: 电子与纸质阅读时长变化

sentences.text: The chart contrasts an upward trend in digital reading with a downward trend in print reading between 2018 and 2024.
sentences.translation: 图表对照2018至2024年电子阅读上升与纸质阅读下降的趋势。

sentences.text: Digital reading rose steadily from two to six hours weekly; the corresponding figure for print declined gradually from six to two.
sentences.translation: 电子阅读由每周两小时稳步升至六小时，纸质阅读的对应数值由六小时逐渐降至两小时。

sentences.text: In 2021, a turning point, the figures were almost equal; digital reading subsequently reversed the pattern of print dominance.
sentences.translation: 2021年是转折点，两者几乎相等；随后电子阅读逆转了纸质占主导的格局。

sentences.text: Digital resources offer instant access to books without requiring readers to carry them.
sentences.translation: 数字资源让读者无需携带实体书也能即时获取书籍。

sentences.text: This convenience can contribute to a deliberate choice of format, especially for people reading between other commitments.
sentences.translation: 这种便利有助于形成有意识的媒介选择，尤其对在其他事务间隙阅读的人。

sentences.text: Yet choosing a screen does not necessarily mean abandoning deep reading, just as choosing paper does not guarantee concentration.
sentences.translation: 但选择屏幕未必意味着放弃深入阅读，正如选择纸张也不保证专注。

sentences.text: The more useful question is whether either format supports understanding and enjoyment.
sentences.translation: 更有用的问题是：哪种形式支持理解与乐趣。

sentences.text: Readers should protect time for sustained attention and choose materials that suit their purposes.
sentences.translation: 读者应保护持续专注时间，选择符合目的的材料。

sentences.text: By the end, a considerable gap had emerged, but hours alone cannot establish what readers gained over the period.
sentences.translation: 到期末，明显差距已形成，但时长本身不能确定读者在该时期获得了什么。

source.prompt: Write about changes in weekly reading hours using the hypothetical chart. Describe the contrast, suggest reasons and comment. Write about 150 words.
source.authorship: 本项目自编模拟题及范文

essays.title: 餐厅选择与物有所值

sentences.text: Food quality ranks first in this survey, selected by 56% of respondents.
sentences.translation: 食品质量在此调查中排名第一，56%的受访者选择该项。

sentences.text: That share is twice as high as service at 28%, while a smaller proportion, 9%, choose atmosphere.
sentences.translation: 其比例是服务28%的两倍，较小比例9%选择环境。

sentences.text: The remaining share of 7% covers other reasons, leaving quality clearly in the lead.
sentences.translation: 剩余7%涵盖其他原因，食品质量明显领先。

sentences.text: Value for money need not mean the lowest possible price.
sentences.translation: 物有所值未必意味着最低价格。

sentences.text: People may willingly pay more when good ingredients and consistent preparation make a meal dependable.
sentences.translation: 优质食材和稳定制作让用餐可靠时，人们可能愿意多付钱。

sentences.text: A distinctive identity can attract attention, but a restaurant must deliver the experience it promises.
sentences.translation: 鲜明特色能吸引注意，但餐厅必须兑现承诺的体验。

sentences.text: Otherwise, novelty is unlikely to create customer loyalty or repeat visits.
sentences.translation: 否则，新奇很难带来顾客忠诚或再次光顾。

sentences.text: Owners should therefore balance creativity with standards they can maintain every day.
sentences.translation: 因此，经营者应兼顾创意与每天都能保持的标准。

sentences.text: Training staff, checking ingredients and listening to complaints can make a restaurant more trustworthy.
sentences.translation: 培训员工、检查食材并倾听投诉，可以让餐厅更值得信赖。

sentences.text: Value is therefore judged across the whole experience, not at the moment of the first advertisement.
sentences.translation: 因此，价值由整个体验来判断，而不在第一次看到广告时决定。

sentences.text: The aim is to earn confidence rather than depend on promotion alone.
sentences.translation: 目标是赢得信心，而非仅依赖宣传。

source.prompt: Interpret a survey of the main reason for choosing a restaurant. Explain the preferences and comment in about 150 words.
source.authorship: 本项目自编模拟题及范文

amendments.after: Training staff, checking ingredients and listening to complaints can make a restaurant more trustworthy.

amendments.reason: 保留三项原有措施及建立信任的效果，以make宾补表达。

essays.title: 实践课程中的技能与反馈

sentences.text: The survey reports gains from a practical course: 82% mention skills, 70% subject knowledge and 45% teamwork.
sentences.translation: 调查报告实践课程收获：82%提及技能，70%提及学科知识，45%提及团队合作。

sentences.text: Compared with teamwork, individual learning outcomes are more widely reported.
sentences.translation: 与团队合作相比，个人学习收获被报告得更普遍。

sentences.text: Learning by doing can bridge the gap between knowing an idea and putting it into practice.
sentences.translation: 在做中学可弥合了解一个想法与将其付诸实践的差距。

sentences.text: A task with a clear learning goal requires students to exercise judgement, respond to results and reflect on experience.
sentences.translation: 有明确学习目标的任务要求学生运用判断力、回应结果并反思经历。

sentences.text: Meaningful feedback helps them see why an approach worked, creating transferable skills rather than a habit of following instructions.
sentences.translation: 有实际帮助的反馈让他们看清方法为何有效，培养可迁移技能，而非只习惯照指令做。

sentences.text: Completing useful work can also produce a sense of achievement, linking effort with visible results.
sentences.translation: 完成有用工作还可带来成就感，把努力与可见结果联系起来。

sentences.text: Teamwork additionally requires shared goals and complementary roles that make members depend on one another.
sentences.translation: 团队合作还需要共同目标与互补角色，让成员相互依赖。

sentences.text: Teachers can design projects and ask students to reflect on both their understanding and their joint responsibilities.
sentences.translation: 教师可以设计项目，并请学生同时反思自己的理解与共同责任。

sentences.text: A short discussion of decisions and difficulties can connect the finished product with the learning behind it.
sentences.translation: 简短讨论决策与困难，可把最终作品和背后学习联系起来。

sentences.text: Completing a task matters, but understanding how and why it was completed gives practical education its deeper value.
sentences.translation: 完成任务很重要，而理解怎样、为何完成，赋予实践教育更深价值。

source.prompt: A university survey reports gains from a practical course. Describe and interpret the findings, and comment in about 150 words.
source.authorship: 本项目自编模拟题及范文

essays.title: 选择职业道路的依据

sentences.text: The survey asks what matters most in choosing a future path: interests lead at 48%, followed by development opportunities at 35% and starting income at 17%.
sentences.translation: 调查询问未来道路选择中最重要的因素：兴趣48%领先，其次为发展机会35%和起薪17%。

sentences.text: The pattern suggests that immediate pay is not the only concern as students prepare for employment.
sentences.translation: 这一分布表明，学生为就业作准备时，眼前收入并非唯一关切。

sentences.text: Students must weigh the options in light of personal circumstances and incomplete knowledge of the changing workplace.
sentences.translation: 学生必须结合个人处境及对职场的不充分了解权衡选项。

sentences.text: Practical placements can broaden their perspective, help them assess personal strengths and identify their weaknesses.
sentences.translation: 实践岗位可拓宽他们的视野，帮助评估个人优势并发现薄弱处。

sentences.text: Further study may strengthen qualifications, but it is a better fit only when it serves a genuine learning need.
sentences.translation: 深造可能提升资历，但只有服务真实学习需要时才更合适。

sentences.text: Career guidance can provide informed advice about opportunities that may be worth exploring.
sentences.translation: 职业指导可就值得探索的机会提供有依据的建议。

sentences.text: Useful support should protect academic responsibilities while creating time for exploration.
sentences.translation: 有效支持应保护学业责任，同时为探索创造时间。

sentences.text: A choice made deliberately is more valuable than simply following the most fashionable route.
sentences.translation: 经过认真考虑的选择比单纯追随最热门道路更有价值。

sentences.text: There is no universal answer, but clearer information and honest reflection can help students find a direction they can explain and sustain.
sentences.translation: 没有统一答案，但更清楚的信息与诚实反思能帮助学生找到有依据、可坚持的方向。

source.prompt: A survey asks final-year students what they consider most important when choosing their next step. Interpret the data and comment in about 150 words.

essays.title: 健康信息怎样转为行动

sentences.text: The chart distinguishes three abilities: 78% of residents can find health information, 56% can explain it and 34% can apply it to a decision.
sentences.translation: 图表区分三项能力：78%居民能找到健康信息，56%能解释，34%能用于决策。

sentences.text: The pattern reveals a gap between access and use, although the abilities are related.
sentences.translation: 该分布揭示获取与运用的差距，尽管这些能力彼此相关。

sentences.text: To access reliable information, people need more than an internet connection.
sentences.translation: 要获取可靠信息，人们需要的不只是网络连接。

sentences.text: They must judge reliability, compare reliable sources and distinguish misleading claims from sound explanations.
sentences.translation: 他们必须判断可靠性、比较可靠来源，区分误导性说法与可信解释。

sentences.text: Someone may know a recommendation yet remain unsure what it means in their particular circumstances.
sentences.translation: 人们可能知道一条建议，却仍不清楚它对自己处境意味着什么。

sentences.text: Practical guidance can then help them turn knowledge into action, including everyday decisions about disease prevention.
sentences.translation: 随后，实用指导可帮助把知识转为行动，包括有关疾病预防的日常决定。

sentences.text: Difficulty may result from unfamiliar terms rather than an unwillingness to learn.
sentences.translation: 困难可能源于陌生术语，而非不愿学习。

sentences.text: Health education should therefore use plain language and familiar situations, asking residents to explain how advice applies to a concrete example.
sentences.translation: 因此，健康教育应使用通俗语言和熟悉情境，请居民解释建议如何用于具体例子。

sentences.text: Such checks can reveal misunderstandings before information is mistaken for understanding.
sentences.translation: 这类核查可在把接触信息误当理解之前揭示误解。

sentences.text: The goal is health literacy that supports informed action, not simply a larger flow of messages.
sentences.translation: 目标是支持知情行动的健康素养，而不只是更多信息流。

source.prompt: Interpret a hypothetical survey of residents who can find, understand and apply health information. Explain the pattern and comment in about 150 words.
source.authorship: 本项目自编模拟题及范文

essays.title: 数字阅读中的自主选择

sentences.text: A survey identifies interruptions as the main reading difficulty for 52% of students, followed by choosing materials at 29% and finding time at 19%.
sentences.translation: 调查中，52%学生认为干扰是主要阅读困难，其次为选择材料29%与寻找时间19%。

sentences.text: Digital resources are available, but availability alone does not guarantee independent learning in practice.
sentences.translation: 数字资源虽可获得，可得性本身并不保证自主学习。

sentences.text: The same device that provides digital resources also delivers messages and distractions that can put pressure on attention, making sustained attention an essential part of independent learning.
sentences.translation: 提供数字资源的同一设备也会带来给注意力造成压力的消息与干扰，因此持续专注成为自主学习的重要部分。

sentences.text: A reader without a clear purpose may also spend more time browsing than understanding.
sentences.translation: 没有清楚目的的读者也可能把更多时间用在浏览而非理解。

sentences.text: The problem may be related to habits formed around quick responses, rather than to the screen itself.
sentences.translation: 问题可能与围绕即时回应形成的习惯有关，而非屏幕本身。

sentences.text: Students need to access reliable information and make informed choices about both content and the way they use it.
sentences.translation: 学生需要获取可靠信息，并就内容和使用方式作出有依据的选择。

sentences.text: A practical start is to reduce distractions, select one text and reserve a short period for concentrated reading.
sentences.translation: 可行的开始是减少干扰、选定一篇文本，并留出短时专注阅读。

sentences.text: Reflecting on what was learned afterwards can make that choice more deliberate next time.
sentences.translation: 之后反思学到了什么，可让下次选择更有意识。

sentences.text: The benefit of technology depends on purposeful use, not simply the number of articles opened or words displayed.
sentences.translation: 技术收益取决于有目的的使用，而不只取决于打开文章的数量或显示词数。

essays.title: 社区文化中心的多样参与

sentences.text: The survey reports three main benefits of a cultural centre: learning at 65%, social contact at 58% and confidence at 41%.
sentences.translation: 调查报告文化中心的三项主要收益：学习65%、社会交往58%、自信41%。

sentences.text: These overlapping gains suggest that meaningful participation can combine personal growth with a sense of belonging.
sentences.translation: 这些可重叠收益表明，有意义的参与能结合个人成长与归属感。

sentences.text: Accessible public spaces make it easier to meet neighbours, practise skills and maintain relationships.
sentences.translation: 便于使用的公共空间让居民更易结识邻居、练习技能并维系关系。

sentences.text: Intergenerational exchange can connect local traditions with new interests, creating shared memories across age groups.
sentences.translation: 代际交流可联系地方传统与新兴趣，在年龄群体间创造共同回忆。

sentences.text: When adults and children explore together, a family workshop can help them observe closely, exchange questions and strengthen family ties.
sentences.translation: 成人与儿童共同探索时，家庭工作坊能帮助他们仔细观察、交流问题并增进家庭联系。

sentences.text: Yet a centre must respect personal choice if it hopes to meet diverse needs.
sentences.translation: 但中心若想满足多样需要，就必须尊重个人选择。

sentences.text: Clear information about times, costs and access can help less experienced residents decide where to begin.
sentences.translation: 关于时间、费用和使用条件的清楚信息，能帮助经验较少的居民决定从何开始。

sentences.text: Flexible arrangements and shared responsibilities can help people contribute without feeling forced into identical routines.
sentences.translation: 灵活安排与共同责任能让人们作贡献，而不感到被迫遵循相同作息。

sentences.text: The best provision offers opportunities rather than prescriptions.
sentences.translation: 最好的服务提供机会，而不是统一处方。

sentences.text: Its value lies in enabling people to find activities and companionship that matter to them.
sentences.translation: 其价值在于让人们找到对自己有意义的活动与陪伴。

essays.title: 物流扩张的质量条件

sentences.text: The chart shows county deliveries more than doubling from two million parcels in 2020 to five million in 2024, alongside growth in collection points from 40 to 85.
sentences.translation: 图表显示县域快递由2020年200万件增至2024年500万件，达到两倍以上；取件点同时由40个增至85个。

sentences.text: The network can expand rapidly when access and demand reinforce each other.
sentences.translation: 可达性与需求相互促进时，网络能够迅速扩张。

sentences.text: Better transport links and reliable delivery help expand market access for both rural buyers and local producers.
sentences.translation: 更好的交通联系和可靠配送有助于扩大农村买家与当地生产者的市场接入。

sentences.text: These benefits may be driven by local collection points that make distant sellers easier to reach.
sentences.translation: 这些收益可能由让远方卖家更易接触的当地取件点推动。

sentences.text: Public services must develop alongside trade if growth is to support balanced development.
sentences.translation: 若增长要支持均衡发展，公共服务就必须随交易同步发展。

sentences.text: Planning must balance competing needs for speed, decent working conditions and environmental protection.
sentences.translation: 规划必须平衡速度、体面工作条件和环境保护的不同需要。

sentences.text: Environmental costs can rise when more parcels mean unnecessary journeys and excessive packaging.
sentences.translation: 更多包裹造成不必要运输与过度包装时，环境代价可能上升。

sentences.text: Local feedback can identify where collection hours or transport gaps make apparently available services difficult to use.
sentences.translation: 本地反馈可发现取件时段或交通缺口怎样使看似可用的服务难以使用。

sentences.text: Shared routes and reusable materials can improve resource efficiency without removing useful services.
sentences.translation: 共用线路与可重复利用材料能在不减少有用服务的情况下提升资源效率。

sentences.text: Continued progress should therefore concern lasting benefits, not volume alone.
sentences.translation: 因此，持续进步应着眼于持久收益，而不只关注业务量。

essays.title: 节日支出的变化与取舍

sentences.text: The chart shows gift spending falling to a low of 20% in 2020 before recovering to 25% in 2024, compared with 30% in 2018.
sentences.translation: 图表显示礼物支出在2020年降至20%的低点，之后回升至2024年25%，而2018年为30%。

sentences.text: Travel records a modest change from 20% to 22%, while meals rise from 25% to 28%.
sentences.translation: 交通由20%小幅变至22%，聚餐则由25%升至28%。

sentences.text: Other expenses take the remaining share in each year.
sentences.translation: 其他支出在各年占剩余份额。

sentences.text: The pattern may reflect a reassessment of what makes a celebration worthwhile.
sentences.translation: 该分布可能反映对什么使庆祝值得的重新考虑。

sentences.text: A realistic budget asks people to distinguish thoughtful giving from purchases made simply to meet expectations.
sentences.translation: 现实预算要求人们区分用心赠礼与仅为满足外界期待而作的购买。

sentences.text: Spending less on gifts need not weaken relationships if shared time and care remain central.
sentences.translation: 若共同时间与关心仍居核心，礼物少花钱未必削弱关系。

sentences.text: A gift's meaning depends on the relationship behind it, not merely its price.
sentences.translation: 礼物的意义取决于背后的关系，而不只取决于价格。

sentences.text: Small changes across categories can matter when a family has limited resources and several obligations to balance.
sentences.translation: 家庭资源有限、又有多项义务需要兼顾时，各类别中的小变化也可能重要。

sentences.text: In my view, festive spending is worthwhile when it respects family priorities without creating financial strain.
sentences.translation: 在我看来，节日支出若能尊重家庭优先事项，又不造成经济负担，就是值得的。

sentences.text: The aim is a celebration people enjoy and can afford, with generosity expressed through attention as well as money.
sentences.translation: 目标是人们喜欢且能负担的庆祝，让慷慨既通过金钱也通过用心表达。

source.prompt: Interpret hypothetical household holiday spending shares from 2018 to 2024. Describe the changes, suggest reasons and comment in about 150 words.
source.authorship: 本项目自编模拟题及范文
